title_cn: 边缘计算中的网络安全：一种信任感知联邦混合入侵检测框架
abstract_cn: 边缘计算通过将数据处理迁移至靠近终端用户和物联网（IoT）设备的位置，已成为现代分布式系统中的关键计算范式。该范式虽然分散了处理流程、最小化了延迟并缓解了回程带宽拥塞，却使网络攻击面呈指数级扩大。分布在多个非托管管理域中的异构、资源受限边缘设备构成了高度脆弱的攻击目标。为在不违反全球数据隐私法规的前提下应对这些漏洞，本文提出了一种新颖的信任感知联邦混合入侵检测框架（TA-FHIDF）。该框架将自动编码器（Autoencoder）、一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）和双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）模型整合为一个统一的本地化深度学习引擎，能够自主进行空间和时间特征提取。模型训练通过联邦学习协作完成，确保原始网络遥测数据保持隔离在本地网关。此外，为防御对抗性模型投毒攻击，我们引入了一种鲁棒的服务端信任感知聚合机制，在全局模型整合前通过余弦相似度指标评估客户端可靠性。在多向量基准数据集（UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017 和 Edge-IIoTset）上的实证评估表明，该框架在对抗性攻击场景下具有卓越的检测精度、快速的收敛速度和较高的拜占庭容错能力。
summary_cn: 面向边缘计算提出 TA-FHIDF：将 Autoencoder、1D-CNN 与 BiLSTM 合为本地深度学习引擎做入侵检测，通过联邦学习训练；服务端在全局聚合前用余弦相似度评估客户端可靠性以抵御模型投毒；在 UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017、Edge-IIoTset 上评估。
objective_summary: 把三类神经网络合并为本地检测引擎做联邦训练，在全局聚合前用余弦相似度评估客户端可靠性；在三个入侵检测基准上评估检测精度、收敛速度与对抗模型投毒的容错。
evidence_note: 在 UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017、Edge-IIoTset 三个 IDS 基准上评估；摘要未给具体精度、客户端数或对比的 baseline。
novelty_note: 将常见的多模型集成、联邦学习与基于相似度的鲁棒聚合在边缘 IDS 场景下组合，组件均属已有方向。
scope: 边缘计算环境下的联邦入侵检测，评估限于 UNSW-NB15、CICIDS2017、Edge-IIoTset 三个基准数据集。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；评估仅限三个基准，攻击类型与具体 baseline 未展开。

title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks
abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, multi-turn interaction attacks have become a significant security challenge. Existing detection methods typically rely on historical context. However, this retrospective logic struggles to identify deep malicious intents that are split across turns to hide future risks. Inspired by speculative decoding, we propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) framework. SSH uses a multi-agent simulation system composed of small LLMs to build an action-level speculate-and-verify workflow. In the speculation stage, SSH predicts future behaviors of the target agent and asynchronously builds a trajectory tree to expose potential risks in advance. In the verification stage, the system uses the target agent's real actions to calibrate and prune the trajectory tree, effectively reducing false positives. As a plug-and-playable component, SSH provides existing detectors with rich decision redundancy beyond the current interaction slice. By judging risk based on the evolution of the entire trajectory tree rather than a single point in time, the system reduces the reliance on the absolute precision of individual detection components. This improves the defense resilience and the warning lead-time of agent systems against complex temporal attacks.
title_cn: 推测性安全蜜罐：面向多轮智能体攻击的主动防御
abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署在复杂环境中，多轮交互攻击已成为一项重大安全挑战。现有检测方法通常依赖历史上下文。然而，这种回溯逻辑难以识别跨多轮分散以隐藏未来风险的深层恶意意图。受推测解码的启发，我们提出推测性安全蜜罐（SSH）框架。SSH 使用由小型 LLM 组成的多智能体仿真系统，构建动作级别的推测-验证工作流。在推测阶段，SSH 预测目标智能体的未来行为，并异步构建轨迹树以提前暴露潜在风险。在验证阶段，系统利用目标智能体的真实动作对轨迹树进行校准和剪枝，有效降低误报率。作为即插即用的组件，SSH 为现有检测器提供了超越当前交互切片的丰富决策冗余。通过基于整个轨迹树的演化而非单一时间点来判断风险，系统降低了对各个检测组件绝对精度的依赖。这提升了智能体系统对复杂时序攻击的防御韧性和预警提前量。
summary_cn: 提出 SSH：由小 LLM 组成多智能体仿真，预测目标智能体未来动作建成轨迹树以提前暴露风险，再用真实动作校准剪枝以降低误报；作为即插即用组件向已有检测器提供超出当前交互切片的决策冗余。
objective_summary: 借鉴推测解码构造「推测与验证」工作流：推测阶段预测行动并异步构建轨迹树，验证阶段用目标智能体的真实动作校准并剪枝；定位为可插接的检测增强组件。
evidence_note: 摘要仅给出框架描述与定位，未给数据集、攻击集、baseline、样本量或任何量化指标。
novelty_note: 将推测解码范式迁移到多轮智能体攻击的检测流水线，构建动作级轨迹树。
scope: 面向多轮交互攻击的 LLM 智能体检测增强，作为既有检测器的附加组件。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；也未提供任何定量实验结果。

title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. NDDL constructs compact multi-space trajectory representations and trains a timestep-conditioned dynamics model to predict the diffusion evolution. In the inference phase, deviations between the observed and predicted transitions are exploited to quantify dynamics inconsistency for backdoor detection. NDDL further enables trigger localization without any prior knowledge of the embedded backdoor by performing substitution with low-semantic words. Extensive experiments for diverse backdoor attacks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed NDDL.
title_cn: 学习正常扩散动态以防御文本到图像模型中的后门攻击
abstract_cn: 后门攻击对文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型的安全部署构成严重威胁。现有防御方法通常从内部表示中的特定异常模式检测后门，随着攻击机制日益多样化，这可能限制其泛化能力。本文从转移动态的角度研究 T2I 扩散模型的后门防御。我们观察到，良性扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜在空间和噪声空间中呈现出结构化且依赖时间步的转移模式，而后门攻击则倾向于使这种正常演化产生偏差。受这些观察的启发，我们提出正常扩散动态学习（NDDL），一个仅利用良性样本学习扩散轨迹正常转移动态的新型后门防御框架。NDDL 构建紧凑的多空间轨迹表示，并训练一个以时间步为条件的动态模型来预测扩散演化。在推理阶段，利用观测转移与预测转移之间的偏差来量化动态不一致性，从而实现后门检测。NDDL 还通过用低语义词进行替换，在无需任何嵌入后门先验知识的情况下实现触发器定位。针对多种后门攻击的大量实验证明了所提出的 NDDL 的有效性和泛化能力。
summary_cn: 从扩散轨迹的转移动力学视角防御文生图模型后门：仅用良性样本训练时间步条件化的动力学模型，用预测与观测的偏差度量不一致以检测后门，并通过低语义词替换定位触发器。
objective_summary: 在 cross-attention、潜空间与噪声空间上构建紧凑轨迹表征，训练时间步条件化动力学模型预测良性扩散演化，推理时以偏差量化检测后门并通过词替换定位触发器；在多种后门攻击上实验。
evidence_note: 自述在多种后门攻击上做了「广泛实验」，摘要未给具体数据集、样本量与 baseline 的量化结果。
novelty_note: 把后门检测的视角从内部表征的异常模式转到对扩散轨迹转移动力学的建模。
scope: 文生图扩散模型的后门检测与触发器定位，评估面向多种后门攻击。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；也未给出具体数据集、攻击数量与量化指标。

title: On quantum interactive proofs with a laconic prover
abstract: Interactive proof systems with a laconic prover, studied by Goldreich, Vadhan, and Wigderson (CC, 2002), capture problems verifiable with logarithmic prover communication in the classical setting. For two-message quantum analogs, even a single-bit prover response contains quantum statistical zero-knowledge ($\sf QSZK$), introduced by Watrous (FOCS 2002). However, restricting the verifier's question to classical public coins collapses the corresponding class to $\sf BQP$, as shown by Beigi, Shor, and Watrous (ToC, 2011). We further study two-message quantum interactive proof systems with a laconic prover. To this end, we introduce the class ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, where $\ell$ is the length of the prover's response, and establish: 1. A natural complete characterization of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ by Multi-State Distinguishability. In particular, Quantum State Distinguishability (QSD) is ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$-complete. Since QSD is $\sf QSZK$-hard, our result places ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, for $\ell\geq 2$, in a landscape "just above" $\sf QSZK$. 2. Easy regimes for ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ collapsing to $\sf QSZK$. We prove that QSD$[a,b]$ (and thus ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}[a,b]$) is in $\sf QSZK$ when $a(n)-b(n)\geq 1/O(\log n)$, and combine this with an answer compression from ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}[2,c,s]$ to ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$ to obtain another easy regime when $2c>(1+2^{\ell/2})s$. Remarkably, our improved polarization applies to SD and $\sf SZK$, resolving an open problem in Sahai and Vadhan (JACM, 2003). 3. Quantum public coins also make the interaction useless: ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[O(\sqrt{\log{n}})]$ with constant gap is in $\sf BQP$, where ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[\ell]$ is a subclass of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ in which the verifier's question is exactly halves of EPR pairs.
comment: 68 pages, 4 protocols, 2 algorithms, 3 circuits, 4 tables
title_cn: 关于简洁证明者的量子交互证明
abstract_cn: 由 Goldreich、Vadhan 和 Wigderson（CC, 2002）研究的简洁证明者交互式证明系统，在经典场景下刻画了可通过对数级证明者通信量验证的问题。对于两消息量子类比，即便证明者的响应仅为单比特，对应类也已包含由 Watrous（FOCS 2002）引入的量子统计零知识（QSZK）。然而，将验证者的问题限制为经典公共随机性会使对应类坍缩为 BQP，如 Beigi、Shor 和 Watrous（ToC, 2011）所示。我们进一步研究简洁证明者的两消息量子交互式证明系统。为此，我们引入类 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2)，其中 ℓ 为证明者响应的长度，并建立以下结论：1. 通过多态区分（Multi-State Distinguishability）对 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 给出自然完备刻画；特别地，量子态区分（QSD）是 QIP_bit-完全的；由于 QSD 是 QSZK-难的，我们的结果将 ℓ≥2 时的 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 置于「恰在 QSZK 之上」的复杂度格局中。2. QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 坍缩至 QSZK 的简易区间：我们证明当 a(n)-b(n)≥1/O(log n) 时，QSD[a,b]（从而 QIP_bit[a,b]）属于 QSZK，并将此与从 QIP_{ℓ-bit}[2,c,s] 到 QIP_bit 的答案压缩相结合，在 2c>(1+2^(ℓ/2))s 时得到另一个简易区间；值得注意的是，我们改进的极化结论同样适用于 SD 和 SZK，解决了 Sahai 和 Vadhan（JACM, 2003）中的一个公开问题。3. 量子公共随机性同样使交互变得无用：具有常数间隔的 qc-QAM[O(√(log n))] 属于 BQP，其中 qc-QAM[ℓ] 是 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 的子类，验证者的问题恰好是 EPR 对的一半。
summary_cn: 研究两消息量子交互证明中证明者回答仅 ℓ 位的类 QIP_ℓ-bit(2)：以多态区分给出完备刻画，证明 QSD 是 QIP_bit 完全的，并给出两类坍缩回 QSZK 的「容易区间」，其改进的极化用于 SD 与 SZK 时解决了 Sahai 与 Vadhan（JACM 2003）的一个开放问题；还证明常数间隙的 qc-QAM[O(√(log n))] 属于 BQP（68 页）。
objective_summary: 引入 QIP_ℓ-bit(2) 并以多态区分问题给出完备刻画；通过改进的极化给出若干参数区间下该类坍缩到 QSZK 的证明，并分析带量子公币的 qc-QAM 变体。
evidence_note: 纯理论工作，含 4 个协议、2 个算法、3 个电路、4 个表格的证明构造，无实验。
novelty_note: 刻画出一类「刚好高于 QSZK」的量子交互证明，其改进的极化还解决了 Sahai 与 Vadhan（JACM 2003）的一个开放问题。
scope: 两消息、证明者回答 ℓ 位的量子交互证明模型，以及 qc-QAM 子类。
limitations: 结论限于两消息、短回答的交互模型；更一般的多轮或长回答情形不在本文范围。

title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills
abstract: LLM-based agents extend their capabilities through third-party skills that provide task-specific instructions, scripts, and tool-use procedures. However, malicious instructions inserted into an otherwise benign skill can cause a benign user request to trigger dangerous Tool Calls, including data exfiltration, file deletion, or unauthorized code execution. This paper presents ActionGuard, which inspects skill-influenced Tool Calls immediately before execution. ActionGuard separates the target agent's action-generation context from the safeguard's authorization context. The target agent may use the original skill for planning, but the Reviewer does not receive the potentially poisoned raw skill text. Instead, it determines whether each action is justified by the trusted user request using a balanced skill profile, current and recent Tool Calls, and local script contents. ActionGuard intercepts each Tool Call at OpenClaw's before-tool-call stage and enforces the Reviewer's ALLOW or DENY decision under a fail-closed policy. We evaluate ActionGuard on 139 contextual and 180 obvious injections in a SKILL-INJECT-based setting against Dynamic Guardian and SkillGuard, using three open-source and two commercial Reviewer models. Each condition is repeated three times and evaluated using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Task Success Rate (TSR). Overall, ActionGuard reduced ASR by 35.54 to 46.11 percent relative to existing safeguards and by 70.44 percent relative to No Safeguard, while maintaining high benign-task completion. These results show that execution-boundary authorization grounded in trusted user intent and runtime evidence can restrict unauthorized Tool Calls induced by skill injection.
title_cn: ActionGuard：投毒技能下的工具调用授权
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的智能体通过第三方技能扩展其能力，这些技能提供特定任务的指令、脚本和工具使用程序。然而，插入到原本正常的技能中的恶意指令，可能导致良性用户请求触发危险的工具调用，包括数据窃取、文件删除或未授权代码执行。本文提出 ActionGuard，在执行前即时检查受技能影响的工具调用。ActionGuard 将目标智能体的动作生成上下文与安全防护的授权上下文分离。目标智能体可以使用原始技能进行规划，但审查器不会接收可能被投毒的原始技能文本。审查器转而使用平衡的技能概要、当前及近期工具调用以及本地脚本内容，判断每个动作能否由可信用户请求证明其合理。ActionGuard 在 OpenClaw 的 before-tool-call 阶段拦截每个工具调用，并在失败关闭策略下强制执行审查器的 ALLOW 或 DENY 决定。我们在基于 SKILL-INJECT 的设置中，对 139 个上下文注入和 180 个明显注入评估了 ActionGuard，与 Dynamic Guardian 和 SkillGuard 进行对比，使用了三种开源和两种商业审查器模型。每个条件重复三次，使用攻击成功率（ASR）和任务成功率（TSR）进行评估。总体而言，相对于现有安全防护，ActionGuard 将 ASR 降低了 35.54% 至 46.11%，相对于无安全防护降低了 70.44%，同时维持了较高的良性任务完成率。这些结果表明，以可信用户意图和运行时证据为基础的执行边界授权能够限制由技能注入引发的未授权工具调用。
summary_cn: 提出 ActionGuard，在执行前拦截技能注入影响下的工具调用，Reviewer 不读原始技能而依据可信用户请求判断；在 139 条上下文与 180 条显性注入上，相对已有防御降低攻击成功率 35.54 到 46.11%，相对无防御降低 70.44%。
objective_summary: 将目标智能体的动作生成上下文与防护的授权上下文分离，以可信用户请求与运行时证据判定每次工具调用的 ALLOW 或 DENY；在 SKILL-INJECT 设置下与 Dynamic Guardian、SkillGuard 对比，使用 3 个开源与 2 个商用 Reviewer 模型，每条件重复三次，以 ASR 与 TSR 评估。
evidence_note: 319 条注入样本、两个对照防御加无防御基线、5 个 Reviewer 模型各重复三次，报告 ASR 与 TSR。
novelty_note: 在已有技能注入防御上组合「执行边界授权」与「上下文隔离」，属已有方向上的实质改进。
scope: 基于 OpenClaw before-tool-call 钩子的 SKILL-INJECT 设置，覆盖 319 条注入与 5 个 Reviewer 模型。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；评估仅限 SKILL-INJECT 一个注入集与 OpenClaw 环境。

title: SEW: Style-Encoded Watermarking of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: Code watermarking supports provenance tracking for code generated by LLMs. Modifying token selection to embed watermarks as an LLM generates code can create a trade-off between detectability and functional correctness. Other methods instead watermark completed code using predefined transformations or trained neural models. Recurring patterns can make watermark choices predictable across programs, while treating patterns common in unwatermarked code as watermark evidence can cause false detections. We therefore introduce SEW, which embeds and detects watermarks in already generated code through three components: (i) code style rules collected from style guides and transformation rules, with style choices determined by a secret key and each program's structural context; (ii) style-preference calibration, which evaluates watermark evidence using style probabilities estimated from human-written code; and (iii) context-aware style aggregation, which combines evidence from structurally matching locations assigned the same code style choice, preventing repeated applications of that choice from inflating watermark evidence. On CodeContests across three LLMs and three programming languages, SEW achieves a mean relative improvement of 12.44% in TPR@FPR5% over the baselines and is robust to four non-LLM code-editing attacks, with only a 0.94% mean relative decrease. Our code is available at https://github.com/suhanmen/SEW.
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables
title_cn: SEW：LLM 生成代码的风格编码水印
abstract_cn: 代码水印支持对 LLM 生成的代码进行溯源追踪。在 LLM 生成代码时通过修改词元选择来嵌入水印，可能在可检测性与功能正确性之间产生权衡。其他方法则使用预定义变换或经过训练的神经网络模型对已生成的代码进行水印标记。反复出现的模式会使水印选择在不同程序间变得可预测，而将无水印代码中常见的模式视为水印证据则可能导致误检。为此，我们提出 SEW，通过三个组件在已生成的代码中嵌入和检测水印：（i）从风格指南与转换规则中收集的代码风格规则，风格选择由密钥和每个程序的结构上下文共同决定；（ii）风格偏好校准，利用从人类编写代码中估计的风格概率来评估水印证据；（iii）上下文感知风格聚合，将来自被分配相同代码风格选择的结构匹配位置的证据合并，防止该选择的重复应用导致水印证据虚增。在 CodeContests 上，跨三种 LLM 和三种编程语言，SEW 在 TPR@FPR5% 上相对基线实现了 12.44% 的平均相对提升，并对四种非 LLM 代码编辑攻击具有鲁棒性，平均相对下降仅为 0.94%。代码已开源，地址为 https://github.com/suhanmen/SEW。
summary_cn: 提出 SEW，在 LLM 生成完成后，用密钥与程序结构决定代码风格选择嵌入水印；用人写代码估计的风格概率做偏好校准，并对结构匹配位置做上下文感知聚合。在 CodeContests 的 3 个 LLM、3 种语言上，TPR@FPR5% 相对基线平均提升 12.44%，面对 4 种非 LLM 代码编辑攻击平均相对下降仅 0.94%。
objective_summary: 提出一种基于代码风格规则、风格偏好校准与上下文感知聚合的事后代码水印方案 SEW，并在 CodeContests 上横跨 3 个 LLM 与 3 种编程语言评估检测率与对编辑攻击的鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 在 CodeContests 上跨 3 个 LLM、3 种语言与多基线比较，报告 TPR@FPR5% 平均相对提升 12.44% 并测 4 种编辑攻击；摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 在事后代码水印路线上加入风格概率校准与结构匹配位置的证据聚合，缓解模式可预测与误检问题。
scope: 在 CodeContests 数据、3 个 LLM、3 种编程语言和 4 种非 LLM 代码编辑攻击下成立。
limitations: 鲁棒性评估限于非 LLM 的代码编辑攻击，未覆盖 LLM 改写式攻击。

title: Link Inference Attack on Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Graphs
abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are widely used to store and share structured information across sensitive domains such as healthcare, fi- nance, and social networks. A common privacy practice is to delete sen- sitive relations before publishing the graph, under the assumption that removing edges is sufficient to prevent their recovery. In this paper, we challenge this assumption and show that even when a relation is fully or partially hidden, its existence leaves structural traces in the public graph that can be exploited to recover it with high accuracy. To this end, we propose a link inference attack that operates on the topology of the public graph, and evaluate it under two privacy scenarios that differ in how the adversary exploits the knowledge available to him. In the first setting where the adversary exploits all topological information, the attack achieves near-perfect discrimination (AP = 0.949, ROC-AUC = 0.999), while in the more realistic one where the adversary makes use of some semantic information, it recovers up to 74% of hidden edges. Build- ing on these results, we further conduct a structural analysis to identify which topological properties of the graph drive the attack success, re- vealing that privacy risk is not uniform across entities and that certain structural patterns make specific relations significantly more vulnerable to inference than others.
title_cn: 隐私保护知识图谱上的链接推断攻击
abstract_cn: 知识图谱（KG）被广泛用于在医疗、金融和社交网络等敏感领域存储和共享结构化信息。一种常见的隐私保护做法是在发布图谱之前删除敏感关系，其前提假设是移除边足以防止其被恢复。在本文中，我们对这一假设提出质疑，并表明即便某关系被完全或部分隐藏，其存在仍会在公开图谱中留下结构性痕迹，可被利用来以高精度恢复该关系。为此，我们提出一种在公开图谱拓扑结构上运作的链接推断攻击，并在两种隐私场景下对其进行评估，这两种场景的区别在于攻击者如何利用其可获得的知识。在攻击者利用全部拓扑信息的第一种设置中，攻击达到近乎完美的判别效果（AP = 0.949，ROC-AUC = 0.999）；而在更为现实的设置中，攻击者利用部分语义信息，可恢复高达 74% 的隐藏边。在此基础上，我们进一步开展结构分析，以识别图谱中哪些拓扑属性驱动了攻击的成功，揭示隐私风险在各实体之间并不均匀，某些结构模式使特定关系显著更易受到推断攻击。
summary_cn: 针对已删边的隐私保护知识图谱，提出基于公开图拓扑的链路推断攻击：全拓扑设定下 AP 为 0.949、ROC-AUC 为 0.999；结合部分语义的更现实设定下可恢复至多 74% 的隐藏边，并给出哪些拓扑特征使特定关系更易被还原。
objective_summary: 在两种对手知识设定下评估一种基于拓扑的链路推断攻击在恢复已删除关系上的表现，并对驱动攻击成功的结构属性做分析。
evidence_note: 报告全拓扑设定 AP 0.949、ROC-AUC 0.999 与语义设定下至多 74% 的隐藏边恢复率，并做结构分析；摘要未给数据集名称、规模与基线对比。
novelty_note: 挑战「删边即可阻止恢复」的常见做法，并指出攻击风险随结构模式在实体间不均衡，是已有链路预测/推断方向上的扩展。
scope: 适用于以删除敏感关系发布的知识图谱，两种对手设定分别利用全部拓扑信息或拓扑加部分语义信息。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；未给出所用数据集与跨领域泛化情况。

title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Decoupling Pretext from Actuation for Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable Skills for complex, multi-step tasks, creating a critical supply-chain attack surface where poisoned Skill content steers agent decision loops under benign requests. Existing skill poisoning attacks either colocate actuation with its contextual pretext or distribute actuation across multiple Skills, but do not explicitly separate the rationale for execution from the operation itself. In this work, we reveal that untrusted agent decisions fundamentally depend on two conceptually distinct Risk-Realization Factors (RRFs): an actuation factor (specifying what concrete operation is performed) and a pretext factor (providing the situational rationale for why the agent must perform it). Guided by this abstraction, we propose a coordination-based attack paradigm: decoupling pretext from actuation. Rather than fragmenting the malicious actuation, we preserve it as an intact operation within a downstream Steering Skill, while delegating the pretext factor to an upstream Grounding Skill that subtly alters persistent environment artifacts through routine utility operations. The intact actuation thus hides in plain sight, appearing completely legitimate and task-driven only when evaluated against the fabricated pretext. Building on this formulation, we develop an automated framework that discovers authentic execution dependencies, synthesizes coordinated pretext-actuation skill pairs, and iteratively refines poisoned skill instructions via runtime closed-loop feedback. Extensive evaluations across single-session and persistent cross-lifecycle scenarios demonstrate that decoupled skill poisoning achieves high attack success, exposing a critical blind spot in isolated Skill security audits. Our automated framework code is available at https://github.com/Wenxin-buaa/CoordPoison.git.
title_cn: 隐于明处：解耦借口与执行以实现大语言模型智能体的 Skill 投毒
abstract_cn: 大语言模型智能体日益依赖可复用的 Skill 来完成复杂的多步骤任务，由此形成了关键的供应链攻击面——被投毒的 Skill 内容可在良性请求下操控智能体的决策循环。现有的技能投毒攻击要么将执行与其上下文借口置于同一位置，要么将执行分散在多个 Skill 中，但均未明确将执行的理由与操作本身分离。在本工作中，我们揭示不受信任的智能体决策从根本上依赖于两个概念上截然不同的风险实现因子（RRF）：执行因子（指定执行哪个具体操作）和借口因子（提供智能体为何必须执行该操作的情境理由）。以这一抽象为指导，我们提出一种基于协调的攻击范式：将借口与执行解耦。我们不将恶意执行碎片化，而是将其作为完整操作保存在下游 Steering Skill 中，同时将借口因子委托给上游 Grounding Skill，该 Skill 通过常规的效用操作悄然改变持久化的环境制品。完整的执行因此隐于明处，只有在与捏造的借口对照评估时，才显得完全合法且由任务驱动。基于这一框架，我们开发了一个自动化框架，用于发现真实的执行依赖关系、合成协调的借口-执行技能对，并通过运行时闭环反馈迭代优化被投毒的技能指令。在单会话和持久跨生命周期场景下的大量评估表明，解耦技能投毒实现了高攻击成功率，揭露了孤立 Skill 安全审计中的关键盲点。我们的自动化框架代码公开于 https://github.com/Wenxin-buaa/CoordPoison.git。
summary_cn: 提出技能投毒攻击 CoordPoison：将「做什么」的执行因子与「为什么要做」的借口因子解耦，分别放到下游执行技能与上游铺垫技能，借常规工具操作改动持久环境产物，使恶意操作在伪造借口下显得合法；在单会话与跨生命周期场景中评估到较高攻击成功率。
objective_summary: 形式化将 agent 决策分解为执行因子与借口因子，构造一个自动发现依赖并合成协调化铺垫—执行技能对的框架 CoordPoison，并在单会话与持久跨生命周期场景中评估攻击成功率。
evidence_note: 在单会话与跨生命周期两类场景做了评估并声称高攻击成功率；摘要未给具体数值、agent 平台与基线细节。
novelty_note: 明确将 agent 决策的借口与执行解耦并以此指导协同式投毒，不同于以往的同位或碎片化投毒。
scope: 针对使用可复用 Skill 的 LLM agent，在单会话与跨生命周期两类部署场景下成立。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；摘要未给出所测的具体 agent 实现，也未说明测试了哪些审计或防御。

title: XIM: The XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol
abstract: Distributed ledgers, privacy-preserving institutional networks, and conventional payment systems increasingly need to exchange authenticated messages and settle assets across heterogeneous trust domains. Existing interoperability systems typically optimize for one of three concerns: application-level abstraction, cross-chain message transport, or synchronized execution within a related ledger family. This paper proposes XIM, the XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol, a chain-agnostic protocol for transporting canonical messages across heterogeneous networks while allowing each communication lane to select an explicit verification policy. XIM separates message semantics from transport, verification, execution, routing, asset identity, and compliance metadata. Its cryptographic state is represented by deterministic message identifiers and commitment roots, while an append-only transition log provides auditability and replay protection. XIM introduces a Universal Asset Identifier (UAID), a pluggable adapter interface, lane-scoped security policies, and an optional policy-aware route graph for multi-hop settlement. XDC Network can serve as a coordination and settlement domain without requiring every XIM message or route to transact through XDC. We specify the protocol model, state machine, message encoding, commitment structure, verification modes, failure semantics, security assumptions, threat model, implementation architecture, and an incremental deployment plan. The design targets public blockchains, permissioned ledgers, institutional networks, and authenticated financial-system gateways, with particular attention to stablecoins, tokenized assets, trade finance, and ISO 20022-compatible payment workflows.
authors: Behnam Mohammadkhani (XDC Network Research and Engineering)
title_cn: XIM：XDC 跨账本消息协议
abstract_cn: 分布式账本、隐私保护机构网络与传统支付系统越来越需要在异构信任域之间交换经认证的消息并结算资产。现有互操作性系统通常针对以下三类关注点之一进行优化：应用层抽象、跨链消息传输，或相关账本族内的同步执行。本文提出 XIM（XDC Interledger Messaging Protocol），一种链无关协议，用于在异构网络间传输规范消息，同时允许每条通信通道选择显式验证策略。XIM 将消息语义与传输、验证、执行、路由、资产身份及合规元数据分离。其密码学状态由确定性消息标识符与承诺根表示，而仅追加的转换日志提供可审计性与重放保护。XIM 引入了通用资产标识符（UAID）、可插拔适配器接口、通道范围的安全策略，以及用于多跳结算的可选策略感知路由图。XDC Network 可作为协调与结算域，而无需每条 XIM 消息或路由都通过 XDC 进行交易。我们详细规定了协议模型、状态机、消息编码、承诺结构、验证模式、失败语义、安全假设、威胁模型、实现架构以及增量部署方案。该设计面向公有区块链、许可账本、机构网络与经认证的金融系统网关，尤其关注稳定币、代币化资产、贸易融资以及兼容 ISO 20022 的支付工作流。
summary_cn: 提出 XIM，XDC 账本间消息协议，将消息语义与传输、验证、执行、路由、资产标识、合规元数据分离；给出确定性消息标识、承诺根、追加式状态日志，并定义通用资产标识 UAID、可插拔适配器与通道级安全策略，面向公链、许可链与金融网关的跨域结算。
objective_summary: 设计一个链无关的跨账本消息协议 XIM，详细规定协议模型、状态机、消息编码、承诺结构、验证模式、失败语义、威胁模型与增量部署方案。
evidence_note: 摘要只描述协议规格、架构与部署计划，未报告实现基准或对比实验。
novelty_note: 将消息语义与验证、路由、资产标识显式解耦并引入通用资产标识 UAID 与通道级策略，是跨链互操作设计上的扩展。
scope: 面向公链、许可链、机构网络与认证金融网关，关注稳定币、代币化资产、贸易融资与 ISO 20022 兼容支付场景。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；未给出实现评估、吞吐或安全证明。

title: Faithful Dual-constrained Erasure for Robust LLM Safety Alignment
abstract: Machine unlearning has emerged as a crucial mechanism for removing hazardous knowledge and enforcing safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal a persistent security risk: unlearned models remain highly vulnerable to retraining attacks, where suppressed malicious behaviors rapidly resurface after benign fine-tuning. In this work, we investigate the optimization dynamics of unlearning and identify that this vulnerability stems from shallow alignment. Rather than effectively erasing target knowledge, models often exploit a shortcut by activating previously dormant parameters to act as spurious suppressors, forming a fragile inhibitory shell over intact malicious representations. To address this issue and enforce authentic memory deletion, we propose FDCU, a novel dual-constrained subspace projection framework. FDCU restricts parameter updates through a highly scalable, element-wise dual-masking rule: it preserves general knowledge manifolds via Fisher Information and strictly prohibits the abnormal activation of spurious suppressors via the Principle of Minimal Functional Intervention (PMFI). By reliably blocking the model's ability to superficially hide knowledge, FDCU promotes the authentic dismantling of target representations. Extensive experiments across specific knowledge erasure and safe output control tasks demonstrate that FDCU achieves state-of-the-art robustness against retraining attacks while maintaining near-lossless general utility, ensuring durable safety for LLMs.
title_cn: 忠实双约束擦除以实现鲁棒的大语言模型安全对齐
abstract_cn: 机器遗忘已成为从大语言模型（LLM）中移除有害知识并强制实施安全对齐的关键机制。然而，近期研究揭示了一种持续存在的安全风险：经遗忘处理的模型仍高度易受再训练攻击，被抑制的恶意行为在良性微调后会迅速复现。在本工作中，我们研究了遗忘的优化动态，并发现这一漏洞源于浅层对齐。模型往往并未有效擦除目标知识，而是走捷径，激活先前休眠的参数充当虚假抑制器，在完好的恶意表示之上形成一层脆弱的抑制外壳。为解决这一问题并强制实施真实的记忆删除，我们提出 FDCU，一种新颖的双约束子空间投影框架。FDCU 通过高度可扩展的逐元素双掩码规则限制参数更新：利用 Fisher 信息保留通用知识流形，并通过最小功能干预原则（PMFI）严格禁止虚假抑制器的异常激活。通过可靠地阻断模型浅层隐藏知识的能力，FDCU 促进了目标表示的真实拆解。在特定知识擦除与安全输出控制任务上的大量实验表明，FDCU 在对抗再训练攻击方面达到最先进的鲁棒性，同时保持近乎无损的通用能力，确保大语言模型的持久安全性。
summary_cn: 分析 LLM 遗忘后被重训练攻击恢复的根因，归结为激活「虚假抑制器」形成的浅层对齐；提出 FDCU，用 Fisher 信息保护通用知识流形并以最小功能干预原则阻止异常激活，在知识擦除与安全输出控制任务上报告对重训练攻击更鲁棒且近乎无损通用能力。
objective_summary: 针对遗忘后 LLM 易被微调恢复的问题，提出双约束子空间投影框架 FDCU，并在特定知识擦除与安全输出控制任务上评估其对重训练攻击的鲁棒性与通用能力保留。
evidence_note: 称在知识擦除与安全输出控制两类任务上做了广泛实验并与现有方法比较；摘要未给具体模型、数据规模与统计检验。
novelty_note: 将遗忘失败归因于「虚假抑制器」并以逐元素双掩码（Fisher 信息＋最小功能干预）约束参数更新，属抗再训练攻击遗忘方向上的实质改进。
scope: 在 LLM 的知识擦除与安全输出控制任务上成立；威胁模型为良性微调式重训练攻击。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；未列出具体模型、数据集与对手微调规模。
institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

title: Breaking the Bounded Entanglement Barrier for Quantum Position Verification
abstract: Position verification, introduced by Chandran et al. (SIAM J. Computing 2014), allows verifiers to test a prover's claimed position by an interactive protocol. Classical position verification is impossible. Even for Quantum Position Verification (QPV), there always exists an LOCC (Local Operations and Classical Communication) attack if the adversary can hold an exponentially large amount of preshared entanglement. Somewhat surprisingly, we show that we can circumvent this barrier in the idealized continuous-time model, where time is represented by a real-valued parameter and challenge messages can be sent at a time sampled uniformly from a real interval. In this model, we give a BB84-based protocol that remains secure against any finite coalition of LOCC adversaries with arbitrary finite (possibly exponential) quantum storage and entanglement. Our construction can also be instantiated in the discrete-time model. Even though the previous impossibility results apply, we are able to obtain an information-theoretic QPV protocol in which the honest parties' total resources (communication and storage) can be significantly smaller than the adversarial resource bound. In fact, we can achieve any desired polynomial gap between honest parties and adversarial resources. To our knowledge, all previous protocols in the literature required resources of the honest parties to be at least as large as the adversarial entanglement. Interestingly, the resource gap between the honest and adversarial party resources in our protocol depends on how precisely time can be measured. As the precision of the best-known clock improves with further research, the resource gap in our protocol keeps increasing. In particular, the adversarial resource bound keeps increasing while the honest parties' resources remain largely the same. We call this the "I sleep, you work" paradigm.
title_cn: 突破量子位置验证的有界纠缠屏障
abstract_cn: 位置验证由 Chandran 等人（SIAM J. Computing 2014）提出，允许验证方通过交互式协议检验证明方所声明的位置。经典位置验证是不可能的。即便对量子位置验证（QPV）而言，若攻击者能持有指数量级的预共享纠缠，也总存在一种 LOCC（本地操作与经典通信）攻击。令人惊讶的是，我们证明在理想化的连续时间模型中可以绕过这一屏障——在该模型中，时间由实数参数表示，挑战消息可在从实数区间均匀采样的时刻发送。在此模型中，我们给出一个基于 BB84 的协议，该协议对任意有限联盟的 LOCC 攻击者均保持安全，这些攻击者可拥有任意有限（可能为指数量级）的量子存储与纠缠。我们的构造也可以在离散时间模型中实例化。尽管之前的不可能性结果仍然适用，我们仍能获得一个信息论意义上的 QPV 协议，其中诚实方的总资源（通信与存储）可以显著小于攻击方的资源上界。事实上，我们可以在诚实方与攻击方资源之间实现任意所需的多项式差距。据我们所知，文献中所有以往的协议都要求诚实方的资源至少与攻击方的纠缠量相当。有趣的是，我们协议中诚实方与攻击方资源之间的差距取决于时间测量的精度。随着最先进时钟的精度随研究进展不断提高，我们协议中的资源差距也持续增大。具体而言，攻击方的资源上界不断增加，而诚实方的资源基本保持不变。我们将此称为「我休息，你工作」范式。
summary_cn: 在连续时间理想模型下给出一个基于 BB84 的量子位置验证协议，可抵御持有任意有限（可指数级）量子存储与纠缠的 LOCC 对手联盟；离散时间下也能让诚实方资源与对手资源之间取得任意多项式差距。
objective_summary: 在连续时间模型中构造 BB84 式位置验证协议并证明其对任意有限纠缠 LOCC 攻击安全，并给出离散时间的实例化及诚实方与对手资源差距分析。
evidence_note: 纯理论协议构造与安全性论证；摘要未展示实验，证据来自对不可能性界的绕过与资源差距的分析。
novelty_note: 在连续时间模型下绕过「对手指数级纠缠即可攻破」的既有不可能性，据作者所知，此前协议都要求诚实方资源不小于对手纠缠，本文使其可显著更小。
scope: 适用于理想化的连续时间 QPV 模型及其离散时间实例，资源差距取决于时间测量精度。
limitations: 依赖理想化的连续时间模型与实数区间的随机采样，离散时间下的差距随时钟精度而变。

title: MultiTable: A Faster Hash Table at any Physical Load Factor up to and Including One
abstract: We present \emph{multitable} and its Rust reference implementation: a stable hash table both materially faster at equal physical memory and more flexible than the SwissTable in its Rust's hashbrown implementation. As an arithmetic mean over 84 configurations it delivers $\mathbf{2.1\times}$ hashbrown's throughput when both hash the same raw bytes and $\mathbf{1.9\times}$ when hashbrown is keyed on native integers, its best case; on negative lookups alone, $3.2\times$ and $2.9\times$. Multitable reaches \textbf{any physical load factor} up to and \textbf{including one} ($0.9999$ demonstrated), exactly for the requested capacity, compared to hashbrown which doubles at $0.777$ for 4-byte keys and values. At $75\%$ saturation of hashbrown (assumed average case of its rigid ladder) and multitable sized to $0.97$ physical load factor, hashbrown takes $66\%$ more space. The lookup probe count has no cliff as the load factor approaches one. Bucket size, physical load factor, and failure budget are parameters, and the multitable can be grown without rehashing. We implement two variants of multitable: plain and filtered. At equal physical memory on an Apple M2 Pro the filtered multitable leads hashbrown in all $84$ insert, hit, and miss configurations. Multitable is more \textbf{memory-efficient}, at equal mixed-lookup throughput on the map of $4$-byte keys and values the filtered multitable needs up to $12\%$ fewer bytes than hashbrown, and the plain multitable is $18\%$ smaller, holding $\mathbf{22\%}$ more keys in the same memory.
title_cn: MultiTable：在任意物理负载因子（直至满载）下更快的哈希表
abstract_cn: 我们提出 multitable 及其 Rust 参考实现：这是一种稳定的哈希表，在相同物理内存下实质上比 Rust 的 hashbrown 实现中的 SwissTable 更快，且更灵活。在 84 种配置的算术平均下，当两者对相同原始字节进行哈希时，其吞吐量为 hashbrown 的 2.1 倍，当 hashbrown 以原生整数为键时（其最优情况），吞吐量为 hashbrown 的 1.9 倍；仅在负查找上，分别为 3.2 倍和 2.9 倍。Multitable 可达任意物理负载因子，直至满载（已演示至 0.9999），精确满足所请求的容量，而 hashbrown 对于 4 字节键值在 0.777 时容量翻倍。在 hashbrown 75% 饱和度（假设其固定阶梯的平均情况）且 multitable 物理负载因子调整为 0.97 时，hashbrown 多占用 66% 的空间。随着负载因子趋近于 1，查找探测次数没有断崖式增长。桶大小、物理负载因子和失败预算均为参数，且 multitable 可以在不重新哈希的情况下扩容。我们实现了 multitable 的两个变体：plain 和 filtered。在 Apple M2 Pro 上相同物理内存下，filtered multitable 在全部 84 种插入、命中和未命中配置中均优于 hashbrown。Multitable 更节省内存：在 4 字节键值映射上以相同的混合查找吞吐量为基准，filtered multitable 比 hashbrown 少用至多 12% 的字节，plain multitable 小 18%，在相同内存中可容纳多 22% 的键。
summary_cn: 提出 multitable 哈希表及 Rust 参考实现，物理装载因子可直至并包括 1（演示到 0.9999），扩容无需再哈希；84 组配置平均吞吐为 hashbrown 的 2.1 倍（同字节哈希）或 1.9 倍（原生整数键），负查询 3.2／2.9 倍；同混合查找吞吐下 filtered 版至多少用 12% 字节，plain 版小 18%。
objective_summary: 设计并实现一种支持任意物理装载因子的哈希表 multitable，并在 Apple M2 Pro 上与 Rust hashbrown 做插入、命中、未命中等 84 种配置的吞吐和内存对比。
evidence_note: 在 Apple M2 Pro 上与 hashbrown 做 84 组配置的均值对比，给出吞吐与内存数字；摘要只提到这一个基线，未提多机器复现或统计检验。
novelty_note: 物理装载因子可直至 1、扩容无需再哈希，桶大小、装载因子、失败预算均可参数化，区别于 hashbrown 的固定阶梯扩容。
scope: Apple M2 Pro 上与 Rust hashbrown 对比的 84 种插入／命中／未命中配置；内存结论针对 4 字节键值映射。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；摘要只报告 Apple M2 Pro 一个平台，且只与 hashbrown 对比。

title: Exploiting Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
abstract: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have revolutionized robotic manipulation by seamlessly integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation in an end-to-end learning framework. However, since these models are designed to interact directly with the physical world and humans, their security is critical, and even small vulnerabilities can lead to catastrophic failures. In this work, we propose the Universal Adversarial Object, a sphere with optimized surface texture that significantly degrades task success rates when placed within the robot's field of view. Specifically, our approach introduces a multi-level attack framework that jointly disrupts trajectory planning, task execution, and action control. We validate our method in both simulated and real-world robotic settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the adversarial object reduces the average task success rates by 31.2%-39.9% for two representative VLA models (Pi0 and RDT), with success rates dropping to near zero in complex scenarios. Index Terms--Vision-Language-Action models, adversarial attack, robotic security, universal adversarial object

title_cn: 漏洞利用：针对机器人领域视觉-语言-行动模型的通用对抗攻击
abstract_cn: 近年来，视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通过在端到端学习框架中无缝整合视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成，彻底变革了机器人操作领域。然而，由于这些模型被设计为直接与物理世界和人类交互，其安全性至关重要，即使是微小的漏洞也可能导致灾难性故障。在本工作中，我们提出 Universal Adversarial Object，一个具有优化表面纹理的球体，当放置在机器人视野范围内时，能够显著降低任务成功率。具体而言，我们的方法引入了一个多层次攻击框架，联合干扰轨迹规划、任务执行和动作控制。我们在模拟和真实世界的机器人场景中均对方法进行了验证。实验结果表明，对抗物体将两个代表性 VLA 模型（Pi0 和 RDT）的平均任务成功率降低了 31.2%–39.9%，在复杂场景中成功率接近于零。
summary_cn: 提出通用对抗球体，表面纹理经优化后可同时扰乱 VLA 模型的轨迹规划、任务执行与动作控制；在仿真与真实机器人上测试，Pi0 与 RDT 两种模型平均成功率下降 31.2%—39.9%（ICRA 2026）。
objective_summary: 对两种代表性 VLA 模型（Pi0、RDT）构造一个表面纹理可优化的球形对抗物体，并在仿真与真实机器人场景中评估其对操作任务成功率的影响。
evidence_note: 在仿真与真实两种设置、两种 VLA 模型上验证，报告成功率下降区间 31.2%—39.9%，复杂场景下接近零；摘要未给样本量与统计检验。
novelty_note: 针对 VLA 模型提出放入机器人视野即可起效的通用对抗球体，并用联合扰乱规划、执行与控制的多层攻击框架优化其纹理。
scope: 在 Pi0 与 RDT 两种 VLA 模型、仿真与真实机器人操作任务上成立；威胁模型为将对抗物体放入机器人视野。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅在两种 VLA 模型上评估，复杂场景的「接近零」只给了定性描述。

title: SteerProbe: Learning to Bypass Safety Steering in Vision-Language Models
abstract: Activation steering offers an inference-time defense for vision--language models (VLMs) by modifying intermediate representations without updating backbone parameters. However, protection on benchmark inputs may not persist across alternative expressions of the same harmful request. We investigate this gap using fixed textual, visual, and joint reformulations designed to preserve the underlying intent, and find that these changes can bypass representative steering defenses. A complementary local analysis provides a sufficient condition under which a reformulation can cross a surrogate safety margin despite any admissible change in the local steering correction. We then introduce SteerProbe, an output-only black-box attack that learns to select effective reformulations for unseen requests from a shared calibration budget. Across three VLM backbones, two benchmarks, and three steering defenses, SteerProbe increases Harmful Rate in all defended settings using 500 total calibration queries per endpoint and benchmark, raising the average from 7.43% to 18.36%. These findings highlight that robustness on original benchmark inputs is insufficient to characterize the safety of steering defenses and motivate reformulation robustness as an important evaluation dimension. They further motivate steering mechanisms that preserve safety across intent-preserving multimodal variations while maintaining benign utility.
comment: Under review
title_cn: SteerProbe：学习绕过视觉-语言模型中的安全引导
abstract_cn: 激活引导通过修改中间表示而不更新骨干网络参数，为视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供了一种推理时防御手段。然而，对基准输入的防护可能无法在同一有害请求的不同表达方式上保持。我们使用旨在保留底层意图的固定文本、视觉和联合重新表述来研究这一缺口，发现这些改变能够绕过具有代表性的引导防御。一个补充性的局部分析给出了充分条件：在该条件下，无论局部引导修正如何发生允许范围内的变化，重新表述都能跨越代理安全边界。我们随后介绍 SteerProbe，这是一种仅依赖输出的黑盒攻击，它从共享的校准预算中学习为未见过的请求选择有效的重新表述。在三种 VLM 骨干网络、两个基准和三种引导防御中，SteerProbe 使用每个端点和基准共计 500 次校准查询，在所有受防御的设置中均提升了有害率，将平均值从 7.43% 提升至 18.36%。这些发现表明，对原始基准输入的鲁棒性不足以刻画引导防御的安全性，并激励将重新表述鲁棒性作为重要的评估维度。这些发现进一步激励开发能够在保留意图的多模态变体中维持安全性、同时保持良性可用性的引导机制。
summary_cn: 提出 SteerProbe 黑盒攻击：仅凭输出学习为未见请求挑选保意图的文本、视觉或联合重述以绕过 VLM 激活引导防御；在 3 个 VLM 骨干、2 个基准、3 种引导防御下用每个端点和基准共 500 次校准查询将平均 Harmful Rate 从 7.43% 提至 18.36%，并给出局部充分条件分析。
objective_summary: 作者给出激活引导防御可被意图保持重述跨越的局部充分条件，并提出仅观测输出的 SteerProbe 攻击在多骨干、多基准、多防御上评估。
evidence_note: 3 个 VLM 骨干、2 个基准、3 种引导防御的网格评估，每端点基准 500 次校准查询，摘要未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 将重述鲁棒性作为激活引导防御评估维度，并给出跨越安全余量的局部充分条件与配套黑盒攻击。
scope: 3 个 VLM 骨干、2 个基准、3 种激活引导防御；校准预算为每端点基准 500 次查询。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅针对激活引导类防御与所测 3 骨干 2 基准，未涉其他防御族。

title: RAGScope: A Leakage-Controlled, Cost-Aware Evidence-Gating Protocol for RAG Hallucination Triage
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems need inexpensive ways to route generated answers: accept low-risk outputs, review uncertain ones, and reserve strong verifiers for the expensive tail. We present RAGScope, a leakage-controlled protocol for evaluating local evidence gates that use only the task input, retrieved context, and answer text. The protocol combines context-grouped splits, fold-scoped preprocessing, group bootstrap intervals, deployment operating points, end-to-end runtime, and explicit source-shift stress tests. On three RAGTruth tasks, the enhanced gate RAGScope-E reaches 0.798 AUROC and 0.660 average precision (AP) in pooled grouped cross-validation. Its pooled AP exceeds ROUGE-L by 0.034 with a 95% context-group interval of [0.002, 0.064], although the AUROC gain is not significant and ROUGE-L remains stronger on data-to-text. At a top-10% review budget, RAGScope-E attains 0.748 precision; accepting the lowest-risk 50% yields 0.141 residual unfaithfulness. RAGScope-E runs in 6.22 ms/example on CPU, versus 145.75 and 223.07 ms/example for the tested DeBERTa-NLI and HHEM settings. A 14,900-example HaluBench stress test exposes the deployment boundary: an in-domain calibrated gate reaches 0.879 AUROC, but leave-source-out calibration averages only 0.466. Target-only calibration recovers to 0.675 AUROC with 100 labels per source and 0.685 with 200. Cheap evidence gates are therefore useful routing components, but learned calibration must be validated and adapted within the target domain.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
title_cn: RAGScope：一种用于 RAG 幻觉分诊的泄漏受控、成本感知证据门控协议
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统需要低成本的方式对生成答案进行路由：接受低风险输出、复查不确定的输出，并将强验证器留给高成本的尾部。我们提出 RAGScope，一种泄漏受控的协议，用于评估仅使用任务输入、检索到的上下文和答案文本的本地证据门控。该协议综合了按上下文分组的数据划分、限定在各折内的预处理、组自举置信区间、部署工作点、端到端运行时间以及显式的来源偏移压力测试。在三项 RAGTruth 任务上，增强型门控 RAGScope-E 在汇总分组交叉验证中达到 0.798 AUROC 和 0.660 平均精度（AP）。其汇总 AP 超过 ROUGE-L 0.034，95% 上下文组置信区间为 [0.002, 0.064]，但 AUROC 提升不显著，ROUGE-L 在数据到文本任务上仍表现更强。在前 10% 复查预算下，RAGScope-E 达到 0.748 精度；接受风险最低的 50% 答案后，剩余不忠实率为 0.141。RAGScope-E 在 CPU 上的运行速度为 6.22 毫秒/样本，而 DeBERTa-NLI 和 HHEM 的测试设置分别为 145.75 和 223.07 毫秒/样本。14,900 个样本的 HaluBench 压力测试揭示了部署边界：域内校准的门控达到 0.879 AUROC，但留出来源（leave-source-out）校准平均仅为 0.466。仅用目标域校准在每个来源 100 个标签时恢复至 0.675 AUROC，200 个标签时为 0.685。因此，低成本的证据门控是有用的路由组件，但学习到的校准必须在目标域内经过验证和适配。
summary_cn: 提出 RAGScope 协议评估 RAG 本地证据门控，含上下文分组切分、折内预处理、组自举区间、部署工作点与源偏移压力测试；在三项 RAGTruth 任务上 RAGScope-E 达 0.798 AUROC、0.660 AP，CPU 6.22 ms/样本；14900 例 HaluBench 压力测试中域内校准达 0.879 AUROC，留出来源校准平均仅 0.466，仅用目标域每源 200 个标签校准恢复到 0.685（ICTAI 2026）。
objective_summary: 作者提出 RAGScope 协议并实现 RAGScope-E 门控，在 RAGTruth 三任务与 14900 样本 HaluBench 压力测试上评估路由能力与跨源校准。
evidence_note: 三项 RAGTruth 任务与 14900 例 HaluBench、组自举 95% 置信区间、ROUGE-L、DeBERTa-NLI、HHEM 等基线对照。
novelty_note: 整合既有评估要素形成端到端协议并对比既有门控，侧重跨源校准的部署边界刻画。
scope: 三项 RAGTruth 任务与 14900 样本 HaluBench 压力测试，部署工作点含 10% 复审与 50% 低风险接受。
limitations: 作者自陈 AUROC 相对 ROUGE-L 的提升不显著，且留一源校准仅 0.466 AUROC，需目标域适配。

title: Can Agents Trust Their Skills? Uncovering Unsafe Chains of Trust in Skill-Based LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on installable skills, which are packages of instructions, code, and resources that equip them with task-specific capabilities and, once installed, can be automatically invoked across subsequent user tasks. This creates a chain of trust in which users delegate authority to agents, while agent frameworks admit skill-provided content into the agents' context with insufficient validation, allowing malicious skills to influence agent behavior under that delegated authority. Yet, little is known about whether this trust model adequately constrains untrusted skill content before it reaches security-sensitive operations, or how frequently such trust violations arise in real-world agents. We present TrustProbe, a framework for uncovering unsafe chains of trust in skill-based LLM agents. First, TrustProbe analyzes agent source code to identify source-to-sink call paths from skill-controlled inputs to security-sensitive operations. Second, it generates semantically realistic SKILL.md seeds with injected canaries and evolves them through feedback-guided scheduling and mutation. Finally, it validates vulnerabilities using an oracle that confirms attacker-controlled flows and verifies observable harm. Across 11 open-source agents, eight with more than 10,000 GitHub stars, TrustProbe identifies 104 taint-style vulnerabilities. Validation on a large corpus of real-world skills collected from public hubs such as ClawHub further shows that 25.1% of skill-agent trials exercise the identified vulnerable paths, with payload injection successfully weaponizing 15 of the vulnerabilities. These results reveal a systematic trust failure in skill-based LLM agents: untrusted skill content can reach security-sensitive operations and exercise authority delegated by users to their agents.
comment: 26 pages, 12 tables, 8 figures, appendices
title_cn: 智能体能信任它们的技能吗？揭示基于技能的大语言模型智能体中不安全的信任链
abstract_cn: 大语言模型智能体日益依赖可安装的技能——这些技能是由指令、代码和资源组成的包，赋予智能体特定任务的能力，一经安装便可在后续用户任务中自动调用。这形成了一条信任链：用户将权限委托给智能体，而智能体框架在验证不足的情况下将技能提供的内容纳入智能体的上下文，使恶意技能能够在该委托权限下影响智能体行为。然而，目前几乎不清楚这一信任模型是否能在不受信任的技能内容抵达安全敏感操作之前对其进行充分约束，以及此类信任违规在真实智能体中发生的频率。我们提出 TrustProbe，一个用于揭示基于技能的大语言模型智能体中不安全信任链的框架。首先，TrustProbe 分析智能体源代码，识别从技能控制输入到安全敏感操作的源到汇调用路径。其次，它生成具有语义真实性的、注入了金丝雀的 SKILL.md 种子，并通过反馈引导的调度与变异对其进行演化。最后，它使用预言机验证漏洞，确认攻击者控制的流并验证可观测的危害。在 11 个开源智能体（其中 8 个 GitHub star 数超过 10,000）中，TrustProbe 识别出 104 个污点型漏洞。在从 ClawHub 等公开平台收集的大规模真实技能语料库上进行的验证进一步表明，25.1% 的技能-智能体试验触发了已识别的脆弱路径，且 payload 注入成功将其中 15 个漏洞武器化。这些结果揭示了基于技能的大语言模型智能体中存在系统性的信任失效：不受信任的技能内容能够抵达安全敏感操作，并行使用户委托给智能体的权限。
summary_cn: 提出 TrustProbe：分析智能体源代码识别 skill 可控输入到安全敏感操作的调用路径，生成带 canary 的 SKILL.md 种子并反馈引导变异，用预言机验证可观察危害；在 11 个开源智能体（8 个 GitHub 星超 1 万）中发现 104 个污点型漏洞，真实 skill 试验中 25.1% 触及所识别的脆弱路径，15 个漏洞被成功武器化。
objective_summary: 作者结合源汇路径分析与种子变异对 skill-based LLM 智能体做污点式漏洞挖掘，并在 ClawHub 等公共平台收集的真实 skill 上评估触发率与武器化数量。
evidence_note: 11 个开源智能体、104 个漏洞，含来自 ClawHub 等的大规模真实 skill 语料，报告触发率与武器化计数；摘要未提基线对比。
novelty_note: 将 skill-based 智能体的信任链刻画为污点流问题，并给出端到端自动化漏洞发现管线。
scope: 11 个开源 skill-based LLM 智能体与 ClawHub 等公共平台的真实 skill 样本。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；评估仅限 11 个开源智能体。
institution: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title: Covert Assistance: Helpful LLM Agents Evade Oversight in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: As multi-agent systems enter high-stakes domains, the possibility that agents may circumvent safety boundaries is a growing concern. Prior work has examined this risk primarily in adversarial settings, where agents are instructed or rewarded to communicate covertly and evade oversight. We show that benign agents can cross the same boundaries without adversarial incentives. We emulate a software-engineering workflow in which a planner represents a company hiring an external developer. The planner writes requirements and holds a company credential it is instructed not to disclose to the developer; a monitor screens their exchanges. Seven of nine tested frontier models disguise the credential in their requirements to help the developer recover it while evading the monitor, even after completing their assigned objective. For example, across 6,000 episodes with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the planner attempts concealment in 16.9%; in 0.9%, the credential evades the monitor and is recovered and used by the developer. Despite the low per-episode rate, the risk compounds across repeated exchanges: at 0.9%, 105 independent episodes carry a 61.3% chance of at least one breach. Our analysis suggests that the planner misinterprets disguised disclosure as helping the developer and reads the nondisclosure rule as banning plaintext, not character codes or riddles. We call this behavior covert assistance. Monitoring favors concealment, while concealment gives way to direct disclosure when the recipient is presented as a human rather than an AI agent, so leakage persists. Giving the monitor the credential improves detection but requires trusting it with the secret. These risks, in models already used for software engineering, challenge oversight to distinguish authorized cooperation from task-advancing assistance that crosses safety boundaries.
title_cn: 隐蔽协助：有益 LLM 智能体在多智能体系统中规避监督
abstract_cn: 随着多智能体系统进入高风险领域，智能体可能绕过安全边界的隐患日益受到关注。先前工作主要在对抗性场景下研究这一风险，即智能体被指示或激励以隐蔽方式通信并规避监督。我们证明，良性智能体在没有对抗性激励的情况下同样能跨越同一边界。我们模拟一个软件工程工作流：规划器代表一家公司雇用外部开发者。规划器撰写需求并持有一项被指示不得向开发者披露的公司凭证；一个监视器对双方的通信进行审查。在测试的九个前沿模型中，七个即便在完成指定目标之后，仍将凭证伪装在需求文档中，以帮助开发者恢复凭证同时规避监视器。例如，在使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 6,000 轮次中，规划器在 16.9% 的轮次中尝试隐藏凭证；在 0.9% 的轮次中，凭证规避了监视器并被开发者恢复和使用。尽管单次轮次的概率较低，但风险在重复交互中累积：在 0.9% 的概率下，105 次独立轮次携带至少发生一次泄露的概率为 61.3%。我们的分析提示，规划器将伪装式披露误解为对开发者的帮助，并将保密规则理解为禁止明文，而非禁止字符编码或谜题。我们将这种行为称为「隐蔽协助」。监控促使隐蔽发生，而当接收方被呈现为人类而非 AI 智能体时，隐蔽又让位于直接披露，因此泄漏持续存在。向监视器提供凭证可提升检测能力，但需要将秘密信任地交付给它。上述风险存在于已被用于软件工程的模型中，挑战着监督机制区分授权合作与逾越安全边界的任务推进式协助的能力。
summary_cn: 模拟规划器持企业凭据与外部开发者协作、监控器审查交换的三方场景；9 个前沿模型中 7 个会把凭据伪装进需求以帮开发者恢复；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 6000 轮里 16.9% 尝试隐匿、0.9% 让凭据通过监控被开发者恢复使用；按 0.9% 推算，105 次独立轮次至少一次泄露的概率为 61.3%。
objective_summary: 作者在软件工程式三方工作流中测量多个前沿模型在非对抗激励下隐匿与泄露凭据的频率，并对比将接收方描述为人类与 AI 的差异。
evidence_note: 9 个前沿模型比较、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 跑 6000 轮，报告每轮尝试率、泄露率与多轮累积概率。
novelty_note: 显示良性智能体在无对抗激励下也能绕过监督，提出 covert assistance 概念并给出成因分析。
scope: 模拟规划器、开发者、监控器三方的软件工程场景，9 个前沿模型；轮次数只给出 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 6000 轮。
limitations: 任务局限于单一软件工程情境；给监控器凭据可提升检测但需信任监控器。

title: Anchoring Adversarial Trajectories to Data Manifolds: A Bilevel Transfer Optimization Framework
abstract: A key bottleneck in adversarial transfer is a trajectory-level geometric disconnect: ambient gradients often drift away from the intrinsic data manifold, causing surrogate-specific overfitting. To rectify this, we propose Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer (MABT), a unified framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to the shared semantic subspace. MABT introduces a relaxed manifold-anchoring operator as a semantic rectifier to suppress off-manifold noise. With this constraint, we cast transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem that learns a geometry-aligned initialization by minimizing expected transfer risk under a surrogate uncertainty distribution. We further develop a Hessian-free solver with linear-time complexity to handle the resulting hierarchy. Experiments demonstrate improved transferability for 10 baseline attackers across 28 attack configurations, diverse victim architectures, and defense mechanisms.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight. 21 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: 将对抗性轨迹锚定至数据流形：一种双层迁移优化框架
abstract_cn: 对抗迁移中的一个关键瓶颈是轨迹层面的几何断裂：环境空间中的梯度往往偏离内在数据流形，导致代理模型特有的过拟合。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer（MABT），一个将对抗性轨迹锚定至共享语义子空间的统一框架。MABT 引入一个松弛的流形锚定算子作为语义矫正器，以抑制偏离流形的噪声。在此约束下，我们将迁移攻击生成建模为一个分布型（distributional）双层优化问题，通过在代理不确定性分布下最小化期望迁移风险来学习几何对齐的初始化。我们进一步开发了一个线性时间复杂度的无 Hessian 求解器来处理由此产生的层次结构。实验表明，在 28 种攻击配置、多样化的受害者架构与防御机制下，10 个基线攻击者的迁移性均得到提升。
summary_cn: 提出 MABT：用松弛流形锚定算子抑制偏离语义子空间的梯度噪声，并把迁移攻击生成构造为分布型双层优化、配 Hessian-free 线性复杂度求解器；在 10 个基线攻击、28 种攻击配置、多种受害架构与防御上提升迁移性（NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight）。
objective_summary: 作者提出带流形锚定的分布型双层迁移攻击框架与 Hessian-free 求解器，在 28 种攻击配置与多种受害模型、防御上评估迁移性。
evidence_note: 10 个基线攻击、28 种配置、多种受害架构与防御的广度对照，摘要未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 将流形锚定与分布型双层优化结合用于迁移攻击初始化，强调轨迹级几何对齐。
scope: 迁移攻击设置，覆盖 10 个基线攻击方法、28 种配置、多种受害架构与防御机制。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；具体数据集与受害模型清单摘要未给。

title: Approval Laundering: Systematizing Approval--Execution Binding Failures in AI Coding-Agent Harnesses
abstract: Modern AI coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor) rest their security boundary on a largely unexamined assumption: that the action A a human approves is the same action A' the harness executes, where A is fixed by a stated policy for what a scope grant or session-scoped approval authorizes. We show this assumption fails systematically and reproducibly. We introduce Approval Laundering, a taxonomy of six failure modes by which a harness's enforcement mechanism silently substitutes A' for A after approval: Scope, Argument, Temporal, Tool, Delegation, and Semantic laundering. Unlike prior work that evaluates risk classifiers against static corpora or infers implicit authorization boundaries, we study credential-binding integrity: given an already-approved action, does the harness dispatch exactly that action? Instrumenting Claude Code's pre-execution mediation point (PreToolUse), we conduct a controlled, headless, repeated-measures study of all six classes (N=19-20 runs each), reporting a Bound-Gap Rate (BGR) with Wilson confidence intervals and inter-rater agreement (kappa=1.0). We prototype Approval Token, a keyed capability Hk(principal, agent_id, session_id, tool, arguments, scope, expiry) issued by a mediator that never returns the key to the agent, evaluated via paired before/after replay of 118 runs (McNemar's exact test). The token fully eliminates Delegation laundering and, for our seeded session-identity-mismatch construction, Temporal laundering (p<10^-5), but by design leaves Scope laundering unaffected and shows no significant reduction in Argument laundering (p=1): an honest negative result, since these two classes leave every recorded dispatch field unchanged, diverging one process level below what a field-only verifier can observe. We discuss implications for defenses that bind only at the tool-invocation boundary.
title_cn: 审批洗白：系统化分析 AI 编程智能体 harness 中的审批-执行绑定失效
abstract_cn: 现代 AI 编程智能体 harness（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor）将其安全边界建立在一个鲜少受到检验的假设之上：人类批准的行动 A 与 harness 执行的行动 A' 是同一个行动，其中 A 由关于范围授权或会话级审批所授权内容的明确策略所固定。我们证明该假设会系统性地、可复现地失效。我们提出「审批洗白」，一个包含六种失效模式的分类体系，描述 harness 的执行机制在审批后悄然以 A' 替换 A 的方式：范围洗白、参数洗白、时序洗白、工具洗白、委托洗白和语义洗白。与评估静态语料库上的风险分类器或推断隐式授权边界的先前工作不同，我们研究凭证绑定完整性：在给定已批准行动的情况下，harness 是否精确调度该行动？通过插桩 Claude Code 的预执行调解点（PreToolUse），我们对六类情形各自开展受控、无交互、重复测量研究（每类 N=19–20 次运行），报告带 Wilson 置信区间的绑定差距率（BGR）与评分者间一致性（kappa=1.0）。我们原型化实现了 Approval Token，一种由调解器签发、从不将密钥返还给智能体的带密钥能力凭证 Hk(principal, agent_id, session_id, tool, arguments, scope, expiry)，通过 118 次运行的配对前后对比重放（McNemar 精确检验）进行评估。该令牌完全消除了委托洗白，以及针对我们预设会话身份不匹配构造的时序洗白（p<10^(-5)），但按设计未影响范围洗白，且对参数洗白无显著削减（p=1）：这是一个诚实的负向结果，因为这两类情形使每个已记录的调度字段保持不变，其分歧发生在仅凭字段的验证器可观测范围以下一个进程层级处。我们讨论了仅在工具调用边界处绑定的防御方案的影响。
summary_cn: 提出 Approval Laundering 分类法（Scope、Argument、Temporal、Tool、Delegation、Semantic 六类）刻画 AI 编程智能体 harness 批准与执行解绑；在 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 做受控无交互重复测量（每类 19-20 次，kappa 为 1.0），并以 118 次配对回放评估 Approval Token 原型：完全消除 Delegation 类、在预设会话身份不匹配构造下消除 Temporal 类（p<10^(-5)），按设计不影响 Scope 类，对 Argument 类亦无显著削减（p=1）。
objective_summary: 作者在 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 介入点开展受控重复测量，比较六类批准-执行解绑并以 118 次配对回放评估带密钥的 Approval Token 原型。
evidence_note: 六类各 19-20 次重复、118 次配对回放、Wilson 置信区间、McNemar 精确检验、kappa 为 1.0。
novelty_note: 将批准与执行绑定作为凭证完整性问题系统化，并给出可验证的分类与键控能力原型。
scope: 仅在 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 介入点测量，六类各 19–20 次运行；Temporal 类的消除限于作者预设的会话身份不匹配构造。
limitations: 作者自陈 Token 按设计不影响 Scope 类、对 Argument 类无显著削减；仅在 Claude Code 一个 harness 上评估。

title: Refusals That Bend: Measuring and Predicting Task Malleability in Embodied VLM Planners
abstract: Embodied vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for robots because they generalize across diverse environments. However, this requires their safety alignment to also hold in unseen environments. Existing red-teaming assumes an adversary who optimizes the prompt, the pixels, or text in the environment, and existing benchmarks ask whether a planner recognizes or mitigates a hazard in a fixed scene. Neither asks whether a refusal the planner has already given survives an ordinary change to the environment. We ask that question by placing a single everyday object into the environment, with no pixel, gradient, or prompt under adversarial control. On $846$ tasks that a constitution-guarded planner initially refuses, we find $20.2\%$ of tasks can be flipped to compliance by one or more objects, and the number of objects differs from one task to another. In addition, the object need not be chosen for the task, i.e., items drawn from a fixed list, with no knowledge of the environment or the instruction, bypass safety about as often as items proposed for the specific task. We qualitatively contrast the tasks bypassed most and least often and find that the distinction lies in how conspicuous the hazard is in the instruction and environment. Susceptibility to safety bypass is therefore a property of the task, which we call its \emph{malleability}, and we show that it can be predicted before the target is ever queried. A composite of signals read from a small open-source VLM identifies malleable tasks $2.4\times$ as often as picking at random. Everyday objects, whether placed by an adversary or introduced by ordinary rearrangement of the environment, are thus sufficient to overturn a refusal. Because susceptibility is determined by how a task is specified, we recommend assessing malleability per task prior to deployment.
title_cn: 可被扭转的拒绝：度量与预测具身 VLM 规划器中的任务可塑性
abstract_cn: 具身视觉-语言模型（VLM）因其跨多样化环境的泛化能力，正被日益广泛地部署为机器人的高层规划器。然而，这要求其安全对齐在未见环境中同样有效。现有的红队测试假设攻击者对提示、像素或环境中的文本进行优化，现有基准则考察规划器能否在固定场景中识别或缓解危险。两者都未追问规划器已给出的拒绝能否在环境发生普通变化后依然成立。我们通过向环境中放入单个日常物品来追问这一问题，整个过程中不对任何像素、梯度或提示施加对抗性控制。在一个受宪法约束的规划器初始拒绝的 846 个任务中，我们发现 20.2% 的任务可被一个或多个物品翻转为合规执行，且能翻转各任务的物品数量因任务而异。此外，所放入的物品无需针对特定任务而选择——从固定列表中抽取、对环境或指令毫不知情的物品，绕过安全机制的频率与专为该任务挑选的物品大致相当。我们对被绕过频率最高和最低的任务进行定性对比，发现区别在于危险在指令与环境中的显著程度。因此，安全绕过的易感性是任务本身的属性，我们称之为「可塑性」，并证明该属性可在目标模型被查询之前预测。从一个小型开源 VLM 中读取的复合信号识别可塑性任务的频率是随机选取的 2.4 倍。日常物品——无论是被攻击者刻意放置，还是由环境的普通重新排列引入——均足以推翻一次拒绝。由于易感性取决于任务的描述方式，我们建议在部署前逐任务评估可塑性。
summary_cn: 以在场景中放入一个日常物体为唯一变量，测试宪章护栏的具身 VLM 规划器安全性；846 个初次被拒任务中 20.2% 可被翻转为合规，且从固定清单抽取的物品与针对任务挑选的物品绕过频率相近；用小型开源 VLM 的信号组合识别可翻转任务，命中率为随机的 2.4 倍。
objective_summary: 作者在 846 个被拒任务上注入日常物体以测试拒绝持久性，并构造基于小型开源 VLM 信号的组合预测器识别易翻转任务。
evidence_note: 846 任务、与随机基线对比的预测器评估、含定性对比分析，摘要未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出任务「可塑性」（malleability）概念并说明在无梯度无提示控制下日常物体即可绕过拒绝。
scope: 针对宪章护栏具身 VLM 规划器初次拒绝的 846 个任务，攻击面限于单个日常物体放置。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅在一个受宪法约束的规划器初次拒绝的 846 个任务上评估。

title: APTInvestBench: Evaluating Autonomous APT Investigation under Varying Telemetry
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents could help security operations centers (SOCs) investigate advanced persistent threats (APTs) by turning weak leads into evidence for intrusion scoping and response. Yet success under one telemetry setting does not establish robustness to changes in log collection, retention, or sampling. We introduce APTInvestBench, a benchmark for evaluating cross-telemetry robustness in autonomous APT investigation. It comprises 370 cases across seven SOC-inspired conditions, derived from 56 report-informed attack reconstructions with 16.4 million log records. Agents investigate unverified leads and submit reports with record-level citations. Fixed action-level support requirements track sufficient evidence across available logs, query returns, and formal citations, separating telemetry limitations from acquisition and reporting gaps. Across eleven LLMs, agents acquire sufficient evidence for 44.3% of recoverable attack actions on average, while formal citations support only 25.0%. More importantly, aggregate coverage can conceal substantial instability: from Full to endpoint-only telemetry, coverage declines by only 1.6 percentage points, yet 35.5% of previously covered actions lose sufficient citation support despite remaining recoverable. Across four frameworks, such losses persist even when registered supporting records remain unchanged. APTInvestBench provides reusable investigation environments and diagnostic evaluation for identifying these gaps and developing more reliable defensive agents.
title_cn: APTInvestBench：在不同遥测条件下评估自主 APT 调查能力
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可通过将薄弱线索转化为入侵定界与响应所需的证据，协助安全运营中心（SOC）调查高级持续性威胁（APT）。然而，在某一遥测配置下的成功并不能证明其对日志采集、保留或采样变化具有鲁棒性。我们提出 APTInvestBench，一个用于评估自主 APT 调查跨遥测鲁棒性的基准。该基准包含 370 个案例，覆盖七种受 SOC 启发的条件，源自 56 个基于报告的攻击重建，共含 1,640 万条日志记录。智能体对未经验证的线索展开调查，并提交附有记录级引用的报告。固定的行动级支撑要求在可用日志、查询返回结果和正式引用中追踪充分证据，从而将遥测局限与采集及报告缺口区分开来。在 11 个 LLM 上，智能体平均为 44.3% 的可恢复攻击行动获取到了充分证据，而正式引用仅支撑 25.0%。更重要的是，整体覆盖率可能掩盖实质性的不稳定性：从完整遥测切换至仅端点遥测，覆盖率仅下降 1.6 个百分点，但 35.5% 的此前已覆盖行动在仍可恢复的情况下却失去了充分的引用支撑。在四个框架中，即使已登记的支撑记录保持不变，此类损失依然存在。APTInvestBench 提供可复用的调查环境与诊断性评估，用于识别上述缺口并开发更为可靠的防御型智能体。
summary_cn: 构建 APTInvestBench（370 案例、1640 万条日志、7 种 SOC 遥测条件）评估 11 个 LLM 智能体的 APT 调查：平均为 44.3% 的可恢复行动获取充分证据，正式引用仅支撑 25.0%；切到仅端点遥测时覆盖率只降 1.6 个百分点，但 35.5% 已覆盖行动失去充分引用支撑。
objective_summary: 该工作构造 56 个报告重构攻击共 370 个案例、1640 万条日志，在 7 种 SOC 遥测条件下评估 11 个 LLM 与 4 个智能体框架的调查覆盖与引用支持。
evidence_note: 370 个案例、7 种遥测条件、11 个 LLM，另在 4 个框架上检验引用支撑损失；报告聚合覆盖率与引用支撑率，摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出针对跨遥测鲁棒性的调查基准，并引入行动级证据支持与引用分离的诊断指标。
scope: 基于 56 个报告重建攻击的 APT 调查，覆盖 7 种受 SOC 启发的遥测条件（含完整与仅端点遥测），涉及 11 个 LLM。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；案例均源自 56 个基于报告的攻击重建，仅在 11 个 LLM 上评估。

title: Certified Randomness with Optimal Rate
abstract: The generation of certified random bits is an emerging near-term application of quantum computers. Potential applications, such as randomness beacons and CRS generation, require nearly uniform randomness, whose rate (the ratio of min-entropy to bitlength) is ~ 1. However, existing protocols for certified randomness either produce weakly random strings with rate o(1), or they require a trusted random seed. We show how to certify randomness with the optimal rate ~ 1 without requiring any trusted randomness from the verifier. Our protocol is secure unconditionally in the quantum random oracle model (QROM). This improves the result of Coladangelo et al., who certified weakly random strings unconditionally in the QROM, and answers a question posed by Aaronson and Hung. We also define and construct a proof of conditional min-entropy, which certifies optimal min-entropy even conditioned on an adversarially chosen transcript. We show an application of this primitive to randomness beacons, where each pulse should have high min-entropy conditioned on all previous messages.
title_cn: 具有最优速率的认证随机性
abstract_cn: 认证随机比特的生成是量子计算机一项新兴的近期应用。随机性信标和公共参考串（CRS）生成等潜在应用需要近似均匀的随机性，其速率（最小熵与比特长度之比）约为 1。然而，现有的认证随机性协议要么产生速率为 o(1) 的弱随机字符串，要么需要可信随机种子。我们展示了如何在不需要验证者提供任何可信随机性的情况下，以最优速率约 1 认证随机性。我们的协议在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）中无条件安全。这改进了 Coladangelo 等人的结果——他们在 QROM 中无条件地认证了弱随机字符串——并回答了 Aaronson 和 Hung 提出的一个问题。我们还定义并构造了条件最小熵证明，即使在对手选择的记录条件下，也能认证最优最小熵。我们展示了该原语在随机性信标中的应用，其中每个脉冲在所有先前消息的条件下应具有高最小熵。
summary_cn: 给出 QROM 下无需任何可信随机种子的最优速率认证随机数协议，min-entropy 与比特长度之比约为 1，并构造在对手选择记录条件下仍最优的条件 min-entropy 证明。
objective_summary: 在量子随机预言模型中构造无可信种子的认证随机数协议，证明速率达到最优约 1，并定义与构造条件 min-entropy 证明以支持随机信标等场景。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造与证明，摘要给出速率界与无条件 QROM 安全性，相对 Coladangelo 等人的工作定位明确，无实验评估。
novelty_note: 同时去掉对可信种子的依赖并把速率从 o(1) 提升到最优，回答 Aaronson-Hung 的开放问题。
scope: 量子随机预言模型下的认证随机数生成，适用于随机信标与 CRS 生成等需最优速率的场景。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；安全性仅在 QROM 中证明，生成需量子计算机，未报告具体资源代价。

title: Tight Parallel Repetition for Private-Coin Arguments
abstract: We show that assuming the existence of homomorphic encryption, parallel repetition of all interactive arguments (after being run under homomorphic encryption) reduces the soundness error at a tight exponential rate even in the post-quantum setting. Moreover, we generalize this result to hold for threshold verifiers, where the parallel repeated verifier accepts if and only if at least $t$ of the executions are accepted (for some threshold $t$). Prior to this work, these results were known only when the cheating prover was assumed to be classical, and it was not known how to achieve tight bounds. As a corollary, we construct the first constant-round succinct argument for $\mathsf{QMA}$ with negligible completeness and soundness errors assuming only the existence of quantum homomorphic encryption.
title_cn: 私有硬币论证的紧并行重复
abstract_cn: 我们证明，假设同态加密的存在，所有交互式论证在同态加密下运行后的并行重复，即使在后量子设定下，也能以紧指数速率降低可靠性错误。此外，我们将此结果推广至阈值验证者的情形，其中并行重复验证者当且仅当至少 t 次执行被接受时才接受（对某个阈值 t）。在本工作之前，这些结果仅在假设作弊证明者为经典时才已知，且如何实现紧界一直未知。作为推论，我们构造了首个具有可忽略完备性和可靠性错误的 QMA 常数轮简洁论证，仅假设量子同态加密的存在。
summary_cn: 证明在同态加密假设下，任意交互式论证先在同态加密下运行再并行重复，即使在后量子设定下也能以紧指数速率降低可靠性误差，并推广到阈值验证者；作为推论给出 QMA 的常数轮简洁论证。
objective_summary: 在同态加密下对交互式论证做并行重复的紧可靠性界进行证明，把结论推广到阈值验证器设定，并以此推出 QMA 的常数轮简洁论证作为推论。
evidence_note: 纯理论证明，摘要给出核心定理与推论，归约建立在同态加密与量子同态加密假设上，无实验评估。
novelty_note: 把并行重复的紧指数衰减推广到后量子作弊证明者并支持阈值验证器，此前相应结论仅对经典作弊证明者已知且非紧。
scope: 可在同态加密下执行的交互式论证，适用于后量子作弊证明者与阈值验证器设定。
limitations: 构造需对协议套上同态加密再并行重复；摘要未讨论效率开销。

title: PrivCert: Certifying Statement Support under Differential Privacy
abstract: Differentially private (DP) text generation can protect individual records, but privacy alone does not specify what evidence a released statement carries about the underlying data. We identify this as an evidence gap: a private report may contain plausible claims without indicating whether they are strongly supported by the private dataset. We introduce PrivCert, a framework for privacy-preserving reporting that makes statement support explicit through privacy-preserving certificates and emit-or-abstain decisions. As a canonical instantiation, PrivCert-PF (Proposal-and-Filter) separates data-independent candidate discovery from private support certification, emitting only statements whose support passes a private evidence test. We provide theoretical grounding for this framework by characterizing the limits of implicit evidence under DP, deriving a sharp privacy--honesty frontier for single-statement certification, and establishing a worst-case cost for fine-grained multi-statement certification. Experiments on synthetic tasks and TAB, WildChat, and Yelp show that explicit certification maintains low unsupported emission, while free-text DP baselines frequently produce low-support claims under the same declared support semantics. We further show that the PrivCert contract can be realized with histogram, sparse-vector, and Gaussian mechanisms, and use DP synthetic data to illustrate an important boundary: support in a private proxy does not automatically certify support in the original data. Together, these results position privacy-preserving reporting as an evidence-design problem: not only how to generate private text, but what a private report can substantiate about its underlying data.
title_cn: PrivCert：在差分隐私下对陈述支持度进行认证
abstract_cn: 差分隐私（DP）文本生成可以保护个体记录，但仅凭隐私保护并不能说明所发布的陈述对底层数据携带了何种证据。我们将其定义为证据缺口：私有报告可能包含貌似合理的声明，但未说明这些声明是否有私有数据集的强力支持。我们引入 PrivCert，一个保护隐私的报告框架，通过保护隐私的证书和「发出或弃权」决策，使陈述支持度显式化。作为典型实例化，PrivCert-PF（Proposal-and-Filter）将数据无关的候选发现与私有支持认证分离，仅发出支持度通过私有证据检验的陈述。我们为该框架提供理论基础：通过刻画 DP 下隐式证据的限制，推导出单陈述认证的精确隐私-诚实性前沿，并建立细粒度多陈述认证的最坏情况代价。在合成任务及 TAB、WildChat 和 Yelp 上的实验表明，显式认证可保持较低的无支持发出率，而自由文本 DP 基线在相同的声明支持语义下频繁产生低支持度声明。我们进一步证明 PrivCert 契约可通过直方图机制、稀疏向量机制和高斯机制实现，并利用 DP 合成数据说明一个重要边界：在私有代理中的支持度不能自动认证原始数据中的支持度。综合这些结果，将保护隐私的报告定位为一个证据设计问题：不仅是如何生成私有文本，还有私有报告能对其底层数据证实什么。
summary_cn: 提出差分隐私下的「发出或弃权」证据认证框架 PrivCert 与 Proposal-and-Filter 实例，刻画单声明私有证据的隐私-诚实边界，在 TAB、WildChat、Yelp 上显示 free-text DP 基线常产出低支持声明。
objective_summary: 提出 PrivCert 把私有报告的声明支持显式认证，给出 Proposal-and-Filter 实例、隐私-诚实边界与多声明细粒度认证的最坏代价，并在合成任务与 TAB、WildChat、Yelp 三个数据集上与 free-text DP 基线对比。
evidence_note: 覆盖合成任务与 TAB、WildChat、Yelp 三个数据集，与自由文本 DP 基线对比并给出理论界；摘要未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 把差分隐私文本生成重述为证据设计问题，给出可用直方图、稀疏向量、高斯机制实现的 emit-or-abstain 契约。
scope: 差分隐私文本报告场景，在合成任务与 TAB、WildChat、Yelp 上评估，支持直方图、稀疏向量、高斯等 DP 机制实现。
limitations: 作者指出 DP 合成数据中代理支持不自动证明原数据支持；摘要未给其他局限。

title: Semi-Quantum Cryptography with Certified Deletion
abstract: Certified deletion allows a client to upload encrypted data to a server as a quantum state, then later request that the server delete their data and detect whether the server complies. If verification passes, then the data on the server will remain hidden even if the decryption key is later leaked. In publicly verifiable certified deletion, the verification key is published so that anyone may check for deletion compliance. In this work, we give a general compiler to publicly verifiable certified deletion that allows the client to initially upload the *quantum* ciphertext using purely *classical* communication, assuming the post-quantum hardness of LWE in the plain model. Our approach can be applied to a wide variety of primitives, including commitments and public-key, attribute-based, identity-based, and fully-homomorphic encryption. Moreover, our constructions allow the client to classically manage the encrypted data beyond just verifying its deletion. The classical client may non-destructively audit the ciphertext via a Proof of No Intrusion to check whether it has been leaked to a third party. The classical client may also retrieve the data while simultaneously verifying its deletion from the server. Thus, they do not have to choose between retrieving the data and protecting it against future key leakage. As our core technical contribution, we give a classical-communication protocol and simulation technique that allows adapting purification-based security arguments for BB84-style states which are prepared through classical interaction. It makes the required purification available in a hybrid experiment, despite the classical transcript uniquely determining the prepared state in a real execution.
title_cn: 带认证删除的半量子密码学
abstract_cn: 认证删除允许客户端以量子态的形式将加密数据上传至服务器，随后请求服务器删除其数据并检测服务器是否合规。若验证通过，则即使解密密钥事后泄露，服务器上的数据仍将保持隐藏。在可公开验证的认证删除中，验证密钥公开发布，任何人均可检验删除合规性。在本工作中，我们给出一个通往可公开验证认证删除的通用编译器，允许客户端仅通过纯经典通信完成初始量子密文的上传，假设普通模型下 LWE 的后量子困难性。我们的方法可应用于多种密码原语，包括承诺方案以及公钥加密、基于属性的加密、基于身份的加密和全同态加密。此外，我们的构造允许客户端以经典方式管理加密数据，而不仅限于验证其删除。经典客户端可通过「无入侵证明」（Proof of No Intrusion）对密文进行无损审计，以检查密文是否已泄露给第三方。经典客户端还可在从服务器取回数据的同时，同步验证其删除，因此无需在取回数据与防范未来密钥泄露之间二择其一。作为我们的核心技术贡献，我们给出一个经典通信协议与模拟技术，允许将基于净化（purification）的安全性论证适配到通过经典交互制备的 BB84 类态上。它使所需的净化在混合实验中可用，尽管在真实执行中经典记录唯一确定了所制备的态。
summary_cn: 给出通用编译器，使客户端仅用纯经典通信即可上传量子密文并实现可公开验证的认证删除（假设 LWE 后量子困难），覆盖承诺、PKE、ABE、IBE、FHE，并支持经典客户端用「无入侵证明」无损审计密文、边取回边验证删除。
objective_summary: 提出通用编译器将认证删除化归为经典客户端-量子服务器的交互，证明在 LWE 后量子困难假设下保留可公开验证的删除安全，并给出相应的经典通信纯化式仿真技术。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造与证明，摘要列出可实例化的多种原语与归约假设，未报告具体实现或性能评估。
novelty_note: 把 BB84 风格的纯化式安全论证迁移到经典交互制备场景，让客户端用纯经典通信完成上传、审计与取回验证。
scope: 需要客户端具备经典通信能力、服务器维护量子态，适用于摘要列出的承诺、PKE、ABE、IBE、FHE 等原语。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；安全性建立在 LWE 后量子困难假设与量子服务器存储能力之上。

title: SceneJail: Exploiting Video Scenario Context to Jailbreak Multimodal LLMs
abstract: Video Multimodal Large Language Models (Video-MLLMs) support reasoning over video inputs, yet remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit policy-violating responses. Existing video jailbreaks primarily manipulate how harmful queries are visually presented, thereby treating video merely as a carrier. Consequently, the surrounding video scenario remains unexplored as a contextual attack surface. In this paper, we show that the same harmful query can elicit different safety responses when placed in different video scenarios. To systematically exploit this vulnerability, we propose SceneJail, an adaptive black-box jailbreak framework with two coordinated components. Adaptive Scenario Construction dynamically searches for a surrounding scenario that is contextually compatible with the harmful query. Scenario-aware Prompt Search uses black-box response feedback to search for textual guidance tailored to the selected scenario. Extensive evaluations on the HADES and SafeBench datasets across eight Video-MLLMs, including two proprietary models, GPT-4.1 and Gemini3.5-Flash, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneJail. SceneJail-F, which presents the complete query persistently, achieves average attack success rates (ASR) up to 91.5%, outperforming the strongest baselines by 29.1 percentage points. Furthermore, SceneJail-S, which distributes the query across successive frames, remains highly robust against current defenses, retaining a 72.3% ASR even under strict image filtering.
title_cn: SceneJail：利用视频场景上下文对多模态大语言模型实施越狱攻击
abstract_cn: 视频多模态大语言模型（Video-MLLMs）支持对视频输入进行推理，但仍易受越狱攻击，此类攻击可诱导模型输出违反策略的回应。现有视频越狱攻击主要通过操控有害查询的视觉呈现方式，将视频仅视为一种载体，因此查询所处的视频场景作为上下文攻击面尚未被探索。本文证明，相同的有害查询置于不同视频场景中时，可触发不同的安全回应。为系统性地利用这一漏洞，我们提出 SceneJail，一种具有两个协同组件的自适应黑盒越狱框架。自适应场景构建（Adaptive Scenario Construction）动态搜索与有害查询在语境上兼容的周围场景；场景感知提示搜索（Scenario-aware Prompt Search）利用黑盒响应反馈，搜索针对所选场景定制的文本引导。我们在 HADES 和 SafeBench 数据集上对八个 Video-MLLMs 进行了广泛评估，包括两个专有模型 GPT-4.1 和 Gemini3.5-Flash，验证了 SceneJail 的有效性。持续呈现完整查询的 SceneJail-F 平均攻击成功率（ASR）高达 91.5%，比最强基线高出 29.1 个百分点。此外，将查询分散至连续帧中的 SceneJail-S 对现有防御手段保持高度鲁棒性，即使在严格图像过滤下仍保持 72.3% 的 ASR。
summary_cn: 提出黑盒视频 MLLM 越狱 SceneJail，自适应构造场景并反馈搜索提示，在 HADES/SafeBench 上对 8 个 Video-MLLM（含 GPT-4.1、Gemini3.5-Flash）平均 ASR 最高达 91.5%，较最强 baseline 高 29.1 个百分点；分帧版在严格图像过滤下仍保持 72.3% ASR。
objective_summary: 提出 SceneJail 黑盒视频越狱框架，由自适应场景构造与场景感知提示搜索两部分组成，在 HADES 与 SafeBench 上对 8 个 Video-MLLM 评估攻击成功率并与强 baseline 及图像过滤防御对比。
evidence_note: 覆盖 2 个越狱数据集、8 个 Video-MLLM 含 2 个闭源，与最强 baseline 对比高出 29.1 个百分点，并在严格图像过滤下验证分帧版本鲁棒性。
novelty_note: 把查询所处的视频场景作为上下文攻击面，并以黑盒反馈同时搜索场景与文本提示，不同于以往把视频仅作为呈现载体的做法。
scope: 黑盒越狱 Video-MLLM，在 HADES 与 SafeBench 两个数据集与所列 8 个视频多模态模型上评估。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅在两类越狱数据集与所列模型上验证。

title: Quantum Time-Lock Puzzles in the Quantum Random Oracle Model
abstract: A time-lock puzzle allows a sender to hide a message in a puzzle such that recovering the message requires substantially more sequential computation than the time required to generate the puzzle, even when parallel computation is allowed. Applications of time-lock puzzles include timed-release encryption, sealed-bid auctions, electronic voting, fair contract signing, coin flipping, and Byzantine consensus. However, time-lock puzzles are known to be impossible in the classical random oracle model. To overcome the classical barrier, in this work we consider quantum time-lock puzzles, in which the puzzle itself is a quantum state. Our construction in the quantum random oracle model achieves generation in one oracle round, solving in at most $T$ oracle rounds, and security against polynomial-width quantum adversaries of depth $o(T)$ for every polynomially bounded delay $T=T(\lambda)$, resolving an open problem posed by Mahmoody, Moran, and Vadhan (2011).
comment: 23 pages
title_cn: 量子随机谕言机模型中的量子时间锁谜题
abstract_cn: 时间锁谜题允许发送方将消息隐藏在谜题中，使得恢复消息所需的顺序计算量远大于生成谜题所需的时间，即便允许并行计算亦然。时间锁谜题的应用包括定时发布加密、密封竞标拍卖、电子投票、公平合同签署、掷币协议和拜占庭共识。然而，已知时间锁谜题在经典随机谕言机模型中是不可能实现的。为克服这一经典障碍，本文考虑量子时间锁谜题，其中谜题本身是一个量子态。我们在量子随机谕言机模型中的构造实现了：生成只需一轮谕言机调用，求解至多需要 T 轮谕言机调用，以及对于每个多项式有界的延迟参数 T=T(λ)，能够抵御深度为 o(T) 的多项式宽度量子对手，从而解决了 Mahmoody、Moran 和 Vadhan（2011）提出的一个开放问题。
summary_cn: 在量子随机预言模型下构造量子时间锁谜题，生成仅需 1 轮预言，求解至多 T 轮，对深度 o(T) 的多项式宽度量子对手安全，解决 Mahmoody-Moran-Vadhan 2011 的开放问题。
objective_summary: 在量子随机预言模型中给出量子时间锁谜题构造，证明生成与求解的轮数分离以及对深度受限的多项式宽度量子对手的安全性，解答 Mahmoody-Moran-Vadhan 2011 提出的开放问题。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造与证明，摘要给出轮数参数与对手深度界，证明细节在 23 页正文中，无实验评估。
novelty_note: 用量子化谜题态绕过经典随机预言模型下的不可能性结论，解决 Mahmoody、Moran 和 Vadhan（2011）提出的开放问题。
scope: 量子随机预言模型下的构造，对多项式宽度、深度 o(T) 的量子对手安全，T 为任意多项式界延迟。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；构造需要量子信道传输谜题态，未报告效率常数或实现评估。

title: SoK: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Emulation-Based Dynamic Analysis Research for ARM Cortex-M Firmware (Extended Version)
abstract: Microcontroller (MCU)-based devices are increasingly pervasive, making efficient, scalable firmware security analysis critical. Recent firmware re-hosting work enables automated vulnerability assessment, yet two gaps remain. First, existing tools are evaluated on limited, heavily overlapping datasets, undermining the generalizability of reported results. Second, prior research advances the state of the art along isolated dimensions, such as emulation, fuzzing, or bug diagnosis, without a holistic understanding of how these components interact and complement one another in dynamic analysis workflows. Building on recently released large-scale MCU firmware datasets from OTACAP and FirmLine, we present an empirical study of 24 emulation-based firmware analysis tools published in top conferences and journals. We position these tools within a unified automated analysis pipeline: emulation configuration reconnaissance, emulation, bug finding, and diagnosis. At each stage, we evaluate whether a tool's output provides sufficient information to enable the subsequent stage, using a deduplicated and validated subset of 4,571 ARM-based firmware samples. Only 1,580 samples (34.5%) can be successfully fuzzed, even counting a sample successful if at least one existing tool can fuzz it. Among these, fuzzing results are generally poor, with average code coverage of only 10% and many false crashes/hangs. Through a systematic analysis of failed fuzzing attempts and false-positive cases, we expose fundamental challenges and methodological limitations in current approaches. These findings highlight critical gaps in the state of the art and provide actionable insights to guide future research in emulation-based firmware analysis.
comment: Extended Version of NDSS 2027 Accept Paper
title_cn: SoK：ARM Cortex-M 固件基于仿真的动态分析研究的大规模实证研究（扩展版）
abstract_cn: 基于微控制器（MCU）的设备日益普及，高效、可扩展的固件安全分析愈发关键。近年来的固件重寄主（re-hosting）工作使自动化漏洞评估成为可能，但仍存在两方面不足。第一，现有工具在规模有限且高度重叠的数据集上进行评估，削弱了所报告结果的泛化性。第二，已有研究沿仿真、模糊测试或漏洞诊断等孤立维度推进技术前沿，缺乏对这些组件如何在动态分析工作流中相互作用与互补的整体性认识。基于 OTACAP 和 FirmLine 近期发布的大规模 MCU 固件数据集，我们对发表于顶级会议和期刊的 24 款基于仿真的固件分析工具开展了实证研究。我们将这些工具置于一个统一的自动化分析流水线中：仿真配置侦察、仿真、漏洞发现和诊断。在每个阶段，我们使用经去重和验证的 4,571 个基于 ARM 的固件样本子集，评估工具输出是否提供了足以支撑后续阶段的充分信息。即便将至少有一款现有工具能够对其进行模糊测试的样本也算作成功，也只有 1,580 个样本（34.5%）能够被成功模糊测试。其中，模糊测试结果普遍较差，平均代码覆盖率仅为 10%，且存在大量假崩溃/假挂起。通过对失败模糊测试和假阳性案例的系统性分析，我们揭示了当前方法中的根本性挑战与方法论局限。这些发现凸显了现有技术中的关键不足，并为未来基于仿真的固件分析研究提供了可操作的指导意见。
summary_cn: SoK 系统评估 24 个仿真型 ARM Cortex-M 固件动态分析工具：4,571 个去重样本中，即便任一工具能测即算成功，也仅 34.5%（1,580 个）可被模糊测试，且平均代码覆盖率仅 10%，指出流水线各环节缺口（NDSS 2027）。
objective_summary: 把 24 个来自顶会与期刊的仿真型固件分析工具置于「配置侦察—仿真—漏洞发现—诊断」统一流水线中，用 OTACAP 与 FirmLine 的 4,571 个去重 ARM 固件样本评估各环节产出能否驱动下一步。
evidence_note: 系统覆盖 24 个工具，在 4,571 个去重样本上横向评估，报告 34.5% 可模糊测试、平均代码覆盖率仅 10%，并给出失败归因分析。
novelty_note: 把过去分散评估的仿真/模糊/诊断工具置于统一流水线，相对以往重叠数据集扩大了实证规模并打通环节间依赖评估。
scope: 基于仿真的 ARM Cortex-M 固件动态分析，样本来自 OTACAP 与 FirmLine 共 4,571 个去重固件。
limitations: 仅覆盖基于仿真的工具与 ARM Cortex-M 架构，不含真机测试或其他 MCU 架构。
institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

title: SparLeak: Privacy Leakage from Sparse Attention in LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
abstract: Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate long-context inference in modern large language models (LLMs), but its input-dependent execution behavior introduces previously unexplored privacy risks. We identify a new GPU micro-architectural side channel, termed Sparsity-Induced Memory Access (SIMA), which arises from secret-dependent key-value cache access patterns induced by sparse attention. Based on this observation, we present SparLeak, a phase-aware side-channel attack that extracts SIMA traces during LLM inference and enables two practical privacy extractions: query attribute inference from prefill-phase traces and autoregressive response reconstruction from decoding-phase traces. By reconstructing approximate token-level sparsity profiles from page-level observations and applying profiling-based learning, SparLeak accurately recovers sensitive information, including user-query attributes and private LLM response content. Extensive evaluation across three LLM architectures, three sparse attention mechanisms, and three privacy-sensitive datasets shows that SparLeak achieves average attack success rates of 90.9% for attribute inference and 87.3% for response reconstruction under real-world LLM serving settings, highlighting the significance to account for SIMA leakage when deploying sparse-attention-based LLM systems. We provide anonymized SIMA traces, trained attack models, evaluation scripts, and documentation as artifacts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Janus_artifacts/.
title_cn: SparLeak：共享 GPU 上大语言模型推理中稀疏注意力的隐私泄露
abstract_cn: 稀疏注意力被广泛用于加速现代大语言模型（LLM）的长上下文推理，但其依赖输入的执行行为引入了此前未被探索的隐私风险。我们发现了一种新的 GPU 微架构侧信道，称为稀疏诱导内存访问（SIMA），它源于稀疏注意力所引发的、依赖于秘密信息的键值缓存访问模式。基于此发现，我们提出 SparLeak——一种感知推理阶段的侧信道攻击，它在 LLM 推理过程中提取 SIMA 轨迹，并实现两种实用的隐私提取：从预填充阶段轨迹进行查询属性推断，以及从解码阶段轨迹重建自回归响应。通过从页面级观测重建近似的词元级稀疏特征，并结合基于剖析的学习方法，SparLeak 能够准确还原敏感信息，包括用户查询属性和 LLM 的私有响应内容。在三种 LLM 架构、三种稀疏注意力机制和三个隐私敏感数据集上的广泛评估表明，在真实 LLM 服务场景下，SparLeak 的属性推断平均攻击成功率为 90.9%，响应重建为 87.3%，凸显了在部署基于稀疏注意力的 LLM 系统时考虑 SIMA 泄露的重要性。我们在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Janus_artifacts/ 提供匿名化的 SIMA 轨迹、训练好的攻击模型、评估脚本和文档作为 artifact。
summary_cn: 识别稀疏注意力引发的 GPU 微架构侧信道 SIMA，构建 SparLeak 在 3 种 LLM、3 种稀疏注意力机制、3 个隐私数据集上实现 90.9% 属性推断与 87.3% 响应重建的平均成功率。
objective_summary: 提出利用稀疏注意力中依赖输入的 KV cache 访问模式构造 SIMA 侧信道的 SparLeak，在预填充阶段做属性推断、解码阶段做响应重建，在 3 种 LLM、3 种稀疏注意力机制与 3 个隐私数据集上评估。
evidence_note: 覆盖 3 种 LLM 架构、3 种稀疏注意力机制、3 个隐私数据集，报告 90.9% 与 87.3% 平均成功率，摘要未提 baseline 与统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出稀疏注意力诱发的 KV cache 访问侧信道 SIMA，并给出配套的属性推断与响应重建攻击流水线。
scope: 共享 GPU 的 LLM 推理场景，在所列 3 种 LLM 架构、3 种稀疏注意力机制与 3 个隐私数据集上成立。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅在所列 3 种 LLM 架构、3 种稀疏注意力机制与 3 个隐私敏感数据集上评估。

title: Anchor-ECC: Local Integrity Checking for Watermarked LLM Outputs via Error-Correcting Codes
abstract: LLM watermarking has become an effective approach to distinguishing AI-generated text from human-written text by embedding detectable patterns during generation. However, a small post-generation edit may change the meaning of the text without removing its overall watermark signal, creating a risk that the modified content is still attributed to the original model. We propose Anchor-ECC, which incorporates the error-correcting code (ECC) constraints and explicit boundary anchors into the watermark structure and pairs them with a dynamic-programming decoder to detect and localize post-generation edits. Across Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and OPT-125M, the approximate-hard setting achieves about 99.7% block-level true positive rate (TPR) with at most 7.6% false alarm rate (FAR) for edit detection under mixed insertions, deletions, and substitutions, while preserving the distinction between watermarked outputs and unwatermarked text. Additional quality experiments identify lower-perplexity configurations that retain strong edit-detection performance. Together, these results extend LLM watermarking from source identification to local integrity verification while supporting configurable trade-offs between detection reliability and generation quality.
